en.s: The siege of Valencia was fought between the Almoravids and the Lordship of Valencia. Valencia was defended by El Cid's widow, Jimena Díaz. After months of siege, the Almoravids occupied the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿尔摩拉维德王朝与瓦伦西亚领主国之间发生了瓦伦西亚围城战。希梅娜·迪亚斯（埃尔·熙德的遗孀）守卫瓦伦西亚。经过数月围困，阿尔摩拉维德军队占领了这座城市。

en.t: Election of Count Adolf of Nassau as King of the Romans in the Dominican monastery of Frankfurt
en.s: King of the Romans (Latin: Rex Romanorum; German: König der Römer) was a royal title used by the king of East Francia following his election by the princes from the reign of Henry II (1002–1024) onward. The title originally referred to any German king between his election and coronation as Holy Roman Emperor by the Pope.

zh.t: 阿道夫伯爵在法兰克福多明我会修道院当选罗马人之王
zh.s: “罗马人之王”（拉丁语：Rex Romanorum；德语：König der Römer）是一个王号，自亨利二世统治时期（1002—1024 年）起，用于经诸侯选举产生的东法兰克国王。该称号最初指当选后、尚未由教皇加冕为神圣罗马皇帝的德国国王。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Pwll Melyn (also known as the Battle of Usk) was a battle between the Welsh and English on 5 May 1405. It was part of the Glyndŵr Rising that lasted from 1400 to 1415. It was the first English victory in a pitched battle during the war. The battle resulted in heavy casualties for the Welsh, including two important commanders, Owain Glyndwr's brother and eldest son.

zh.s: 普尔梅林战役（又称乌斯克战役）是威尔士人与英格兰人于1405年5月5日进行的一场战役，属于1400年至1415年的格林杜尔起义。这是战争中英格兰首次在大规模会战中获胜。威尔士一方损失惨重，阵亡者包括格林杜尔的兄弟和长子这两名重要指挥官。

en.t: On his second voyage to the New World, Christopher Columbus sights Jamaica, landing at Discovery Bay and declares Jamaica the property of the Spanish crown
en.s: Christopher Columbus (; between 25 August and 31 October 1451 – 20 May 1506) was an Italian explorer and navigator from the Republic of Genoa who completed four Spanish transatlantic voyages in the name of the Catholic Monarchs, opening the way for the widespread European exploration and colonization of the Americas. His expeditions were the first known European contact with the Caribbean and Central and South America.

zh.t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布第二次新大陆航行期间发现牙买加，在探索湾登陆并宣布牙买加归西班牙王室所有
zh.s: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布（生于 1451 年 8 月 25 日至 10 月 31 日之间—1506 年 5 月 20 日）是来自热那亚共和国的意大利探险家和航海家。他以天主教双王的名义完成四次西班牙跨大西洋航行，为欧洲人大规模探索和殖民美洲开辟道路。他的远航是欧洲人首次已知接触加勒比地区、中美洲和南美洲。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: In 1599, the Florentines launched an expedition against the Ottoman-held island of Chios. The expedition ended in disaster for the Florentine forces.

zh.s: 1599年，佛罗伦萨人向奥斯曼帝国控制的希俄斯岛发动远征。远征以佛罗伦萨军队惨败告终。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Herbsthausen, 5 May 1645, took place during the Thirty Years' War, near Bad Mergentheim, in Baden-Württemberg. A French army led by Turenne was surprised and comprehensively defeated by a Bavarian force under Franz von Mercy. In February 1645, Mercy had detached 5,000 cavalry to support the Imperial army in Bohemia, most of whom were lost in the defeat at Jankau on 6 March.

zh.s: 赫布斯特豪森战役于1645年5月5日在三十年战争期间爆发，战场位于巴登-符腾堡州巴特梅尔根特海姆附近。蒂雷纳率领的法军遭到弗朗茨·冯·梅西率领的巴伐利亚军队突袭并全面击败。1645年2月，梅西派出5,000名骑兵支援波希米亚的帝国军队，其中大多数人在3月6日扬考战役中战败时损失。

en.t: Cromwell's Act of Grace, which pardoned the people of Scotland for any crimes committed during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, was proclaimed in Edinburgh
en.s: Cromwell's Act of Grace, or, more formally, the Act of Pardon and Grace to the People of Scotland, was an Act of the Parliament of England that declared that the people of Scotland (with certain exceptions) were pardoned for any crimes they might have committed during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was proclaimed at the Mercat Cross in Edinburgh on 5 May 1654.

zh.t: 克伦威尔《恩典法令》在爱丁堡公布
zh.s: 克伦威尔《恩典法令》的正式名称是《赦免与恩典苏格兰人民法令》。该法案由英格兰议会通过，宣布赦免苏格兰人民在三王国战争期间可能犯下的罪行，但有若干例外。法令于1654年5月5日在爱丁堡的麦卡特十字广场公布。

en.s: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg was concluded on 5 May 1762, and ended the fighting in the Seven Years' War between Prussia and Russia. The treaty followed the accession of Emperor Peter III, who admired the Prussian king Frederick the Great. It allowed the latter to concentrate on his other enemies, Austria and Saxony, in what became known as the Second Miracle of the House of Brandenburg.

zh.s: 《圣彼得堡条约》于1762年5月5日缔结，结束了普鲁士与俄罗斯在七年战争中的交战。条约签署前，欣赏普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝的彼得三世继位。条约让腓特烈得以集中力量对付其他敌人奥地利和萨克森，这一局面后来被称为「勃兰登堡王室的第二次奇迹」。

en.s: The Battle of Thouars (5 May 1793) was a battle between Royalist and Republican French forces during the War in the Vendée. The Royalists or Vendeans led by Louis Marie de Lescure, Charles de Bonchamps and Henri de La Rochejaquelein seized the town of Thouars and compelled its Republican defenders under Pierre Quétineau to surrender.

zh.s: 图阿尔战役于1793年5月5日爆发，是旺代战争期间保王派与法国共和派军队之间的一场战斗。路易-马里·德·莱斯屈尔、夏尔·德·邦尚和亨利·德·拉罗什雅克兰率领保王派（旺代军）攻占图阿尔镇，迫使皮埃尔·克蒂诺率领的共和派守军投降。

en.s: The action of 5 May 1794 was a minor naval engagement fought in the Indian Ocean during the French Revolutionary Wars. A British squadron had been blockading the French island of Isle de France (now Mauritius) since early in the year, and early on 5 May discovered two ships approaching their position.

zh.s: 1794年5月5日海战是法国大革命战争期间在印度洋发生的一场小规模海战。年初以来，英国舰队一直封锁法国的法兰西岛（今毛里求斯）。5月5日清晨，英国舰队发现两艘船正驶向其所在位置。

en.s: The Battle of Gonaïves took place during the Haitian Revolution.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 戈纳伊夫战役发生在海地革命期间。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Messkirch (5 May 1800) saw a Republican French army led by Jean Victor Marie Moreau attack a Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Paul Kray. At the start of the 1800 campaign in Germany, Moreau's 108,000-strong field army faced Kray's 120,000-man army on opposite sides of the Rhine River. By a series of maneuvers, Moreau crossed the Rhine and concentrated superior forces to defeat Kray at the Battles of Stockach and Engen on 3 May.

zh.s: 1800年5月5日的梅斯基希战役中，让-维克托·马里·莫罗率领的法国共和军进攻保罗·克雷指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军队。1800年德国战役开始时，莫罗拥有10.8万人的野战军，克雷则有12万人，两军隔莱茵河对峙。莫罗通过一系列机动渡过莱茵河，并集中优势兵力，在5月3日的施托卡赫和恩根战役中击败克雷。

en.s: The invasion of Surinam was a British military campaign which resulted in the capture and occupation of the Dutch colony of Surinam in 1804 during the Napoleonic Wars. Surinam, defended by a weak Batavian garrison under the command of Abraham Jacob van Imbijze van Batenburg, was attacked by a British expeditionary force led by Samuel Hood and Sir Charles Green on 25 April.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 苏里南远征是拿破仑战争期间英国在1804年发动的一场军事行动，最终占领并控制了荷兰殖民地苏里南。苏里南由实力较弱的巴达维亚驻军防守，指挥官是Abraham Jacob van Imbijze van Batenburg。4月25日，Samuel Hood和Charles Green爵士率领的英国远征军发起进攻。

en.s: The Galician Uprising of 1809 was a Polish armed uprising against the Austrian Empire led by Piotr Strzyżewski during the Polish-Austrian War. The rebellion ended with an Insurgent military victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1809年加利西亚起义是波兰-奥地利战争期间，波兰人在Piotr Strzyżewski率领下反抗奥地利帝国的武装起义。起义以起义军获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Fuentes de Oñoro was a military engagement that took place from 3–5 May 1811 during the Peninsular War. An Anglo-Portuguese Army under Wellington checked an attempt by the French Army of Portugal under Marshal André Masséna to relieve the besieged city of Almeida.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 丰特斯-德奥尼奥罗战役
zh.s: 丰特斯-德奥尼奥罗战役于1811年5月3日至5日发生，是半岛战争期间的一场军事交战。威灵顿率领的英葡联军挡住了马塞纳元帅指挥的法国葡萄牙军团，阻止其解围被围困的阿尔梅达城。

en.s: The Blockade of Maastricht of 1814 was a military blockade of the then French fortified city Maastricht by the allied troops led by General Bernadotte. The blockade took place from late January to early May 1814 during the War of the Sixth Coalition between France and the other European powers, ending on 5 May of that year with the capitulation of Maastricht and the departure of the French.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1814年马斯特里赫特围困战是第六次反法同盟战争期间，由贝尔纳多特将军率领的盟军对当时法国设防城市马斯特里赫特实施的军事封锁。封锁从1814年1月底持续到5月初，5月5日以马斯特里赫特投降、法军撤离告终。

en.t: The first edition of The Manchester Guardian, now The Guardian, is published
en.s: The Guardian is a British daily newspaper. It was founded in Manchester in 1821 as The Manchester Guardian and changed its name in 1959, followed by a move to London. Along with its sister paper, The Guardian Weekly, The Guardian is part of the Guardian Media Group, owned by the Scott Trust Limited.

zh.t: 《曼彻斯特卫报》（今《卫报》）创刊号出版
zh.s: 《卫报》是一份英国日报，1821年在曼彻斯特创刊，原名《曼彻斯特卫报》，1959年更名，之后迁至伦敦。《卫报》和其姊妹刊物《卫报周刊》同属卫报媒体集团，该集团由斯科特信托有限公司所有。

en.s: The Battle of Kastraki was a battle of the Greek War of Independence that took place in Kalavryta in 1826 between the Greek revolutionaries and the army of Ibrahim Pasha. Kastraki is a fortified location on Helmos near the village of Solos in Achaea. In 1826, Ibrahim Pasha, after the fall of Missolonghi, passed through the Peloponnese and Patras and headed for Tripoli; on the way he plundered the villages he encountered and enslaved the inhabitants.

zh.s: 卡斯特拉基战役是希腊独立战争期间的一场战役，于1826年在卡拉夫里塔发生，交战双方为希腊革命军和易卜拉欣帕夏的军队。卡斯特拉基是阿哈伊亚州索洛斯村附近赫尔莫斯山上的一处设防地点。1826年，易卜拉欣帕夏在迈索隆吉陷落后，穿过伯罗奔尼撒和帕特雷前往特里波利斯；沿途洗劫所经村庄，并奴役当地居民。

en.s: The Expedition of the Thousand (Italian: Spedizione dei Mille) was an event of the unification of Italy that took place in 1860. A corps of volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi sailed from Quarto al Mare near Genoa and landed in Marsala, Sicily, in order to conquer the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, ruled by the Spanish House of Bourbon-Two Sicilies.

zh.s: 千人远征（意大利语：Spedizione dei Mille）是1860年意大利统一进程中的一项事件。朱塞佩·加里波第率领一支志愿军从热那亚附近的夸尔托阿尔马雷出航，在西西里岛马尔萨拉登陆，目标是征服由西班牙波旁王朝两西西里分支统治的两西西里王国。

en.s: The Battle of Williamsburg, also known as the Battle of Fort Magruder, took place on May 5, 1862, in York County, James City County, and Williamsburg, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula Campaign of the American Civil War. It was the first pitched battle of the Peninsula Campaign, in which nearly 41,000 Federals and 32,000 Confederates were engaged, fighting an inconclusive battle that ended with the Confederates continuing their withdrawal. Following up the Confederate retreat from Yorktown, the Union division of Brig. Gen. Joseph Hooker encountered the Confederate rearguard near Williamsburg. Hooker assaulted Fort Magruder, an earthen fortification alongside the Williamsburg Road, but was repulsed.

zh.s: 威廉斯堡战役也称麦格鲁德堡战役，于1862年5月5日在弗吉尼亚州约克郡、詹姆斯城郡和威廉斯堡发生，是美国南北战争半岛战役的一部分。这是半岛战役中的首次大规模会战，联邦军约4.1万人、邦联军约3.2万人参战。战斗没有分出胜负，邦联军继续撤退。约克镇的邦联军撤退后，准将约瑟夫·胡克率领的联邦军师在威廉斯堡附近遭遇邦联军后卫部队。胡克进攻威廉斯堡大道旁的土木工事麦格鲁德堡，但被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Puebla took place on 5 May 1862, near the city of Puebla during the French intervention in Mexico. The battle ended in a victory for the Mexican Army over the occupying French forces. The French eventually overran the Mexicans in subsequent battles, but the Mexican victory at Puebla against a much better equipped and larger French army provided a significant morale boost to the Mexican army and also helped slow the French army's advance towards Mexico City. There were a total of 10,540 soldiers in the war. 462 French soldiers died in combat.

zh.s: 1862年5月5日，墨西哥法军干涉期间，普埃布拉战役在普埃布拉市附近打响。墨西哥军队击败占领当地的法国军队。法国后来在后续战斗中击败墨西哥军队，但墨西哥军在普埃布拉击败装备更精良、人数更多的法国军队，极大鼓舞了士气，也拖慢了法军向墨西哥城推进的速度。参战士兵共10,540人，462名法国士兵在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The First Battle of Dragoon Springs was a minor skirmish between a small troop of Confederate dragoons of Governor John R. Baylor's Arizona Rangers, and a band of Apache warriors during the American Civil War. It was fought on May 5, 1862, near the present-day town of Benson, Arizona, in Confederate Arizona.

zh.t: 第一次德拉贡斯普林斯战役
zh.s: 第一次德拉贡斯普林斯战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，交战双方为约翰·R·贝勒州长的亚利桑那游骑兵队中的一小队邦联骑兵，以及一支阿帕奇战士队伍。战斗于1862年5月5日在亚利桑那州本森镇附近、邦联亚利桑那地区境内发生。

en.s: The Battle of Lebanon was a small battle fought near Lebanon, Tennessee during the American Civil War on May 5, 1862.

zh.s: 黎巴嫩战役是美国内战期间于1862年5月5日在田纳西州黎巴嫩附近发生的一场小规模战斗。

zh.s: 圣巴勃罗德尔蒙特战役于1863年5月5日在普埃布拉战役期间爆发。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 5 May 1863. The presidential election resulted in a victory for Daniel Bashiel Warner of the Republican Party, defeating Chief Justice Boston Jenkins Drayton. Warner took office on 4 January 1864.

zh.s: 1863年5月5日，利比里亚举行大选。共和党候选人丹尼尔·巴希尔·华纳击败首席大法官波士顿·詹金斯·德雷顿，当选总统。华纳于1864年1月4日就任。

en.s: Battle of Krzykawka was a military engagement that took place during the January Uprising on May 5, 1863, between Russian forces and Polish insurgents and foreign (Italian and French) volunteers allied with them. It took place close to the village of Krzykawka near Olkusz. The Polish forces were led by general Józef Miniewski and included the Italian Garibaldi Legion under the command of Francesco Nullo.

zh.s: 克日卡夫卡战役是1863年1月起义期间的一场军事冲突，于1863年5月5日发生，交战双方为俄军与波兰起义军及其意大利、法国志愿者盟友。战斗地点在奥尔库什附近的克日卡夫卡村一带。波兰军队由Józef Miniewski将军率领，其中包括由Francesco Nullo指挥的加里波第军团。

en.s: The Battle of the Wilderness, fought May 5–7, 1864, was the first battle of Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's 1864 Virginia Overland Campaign against Gen. Robert E. Lee and the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia in the American Civil War. Both armies suffered heavy casualties, a harbinger of a bloody war of attrition by Grant against Lee's army and, eventually, the Confederate capital, Richmond, Virginia. The battle was tactically inconclusive, as Grant disengaged and continued his offensive. Grant attempted to move quickly through the dense underbrush of the Wilderness of Spotsylvania, but Lee launched two of his corps on parallel roads to intercept him.

zh.s: 荒野战役于1864年5月5日至7日进行，是美国南北战争期间尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将率军发起的1864年弗吉尼亚陆上战役的第一场战斗，对手是罗伯特·E·李将军率领的北弗吉尼亚邦联军。双方伤亡惨重，预示着格兰特将对李的军队展开血腥消耗战，最终目标是攻下弗吉尼亚州邦联首都里士满。战术上双方未分胜负，格兰特撤出战斗并继续进攻。格兰特试图快速穿过斯波特西尔瓦尼亚荒野茂密的灌木丛，李则派出两个军团沿平行道路前进，拦截格兰特。

en.s: The Battle of Albemarle Sound was an inconclusive naval battle fought in May 1864 along the coast of North Carolina during the American Civil War. Three Confederate warships, including an ironclad, engaged eight Union gunboats. The action ended indecisively due to the sunset.

zh.s: 阿尔伯马尔湾海战是美国内战期间于1864年5月在北卡罗来纳州沿岸发生的一场未分胜负的海战。三艘邦联军舰（其中包括一艘铁甲舰）与八艘联邦炮艇交战。由于日落，战斗没有分出胜负。

zh.s: 1868 年，佛罗里达州举行了两次美国众议院选举：第一次选出第四十届国会议员，第二次选出第四十一届国会议员。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia in May 1885. In the presidential election, the result was a victory for incumbent Hilary R. W. Johnson of the True Whig Party (the dominant ruling party at the time), who was re-elected for a second term.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1885年5月举行大选。总统选举中，执政真辉党现任总统希拉里·R·W·约翰逊胜出，连任第二个任期。

en.t: Workers marching for the eight-hour day in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, are shot at by Wisconsin National Guardsmen in what becomes known as the Bay View Massacre
en.s: Wisconsin is a state in the Upper Midwest and Great Lakes regions of the United States. It borders Minnesota to the west, Iowa to the southwest, Illinois to the south, Lake Michigan to the east, Michigan to the northeast, and Lake Superior to the north. With a population of about 6 million and an area of about 65,500 square miles (170,000 km2), Wisconsin is the 21st-largest state by population and the 23rd-largest by area.

zh.t: 威斯康星州密尔沃基的工人游行争取八小时工作制，遭州国民警卫队开枪射击，酿成湾景惨案
zh.s: 威斯康星州位于美国中西部上部和五大湖地区。该州西邻明尼苏达州，西南邻爱荷华州，南邻伊利诺伊州，东临密歇根湖，东北邻密歇根州，北濒苏必利尔湖。威斯康星州人口约 600 万，面积约 65,500 平方英里（170,000 平方公里），人口规模居全美第 21 位，面积居第 23 位。

en.t: The Peruvian Academy of Language is founded
en.s: The Peruvian Academy of Language or …of the Language (Academia Peruana de la Lengua, APL) is a cultural institution that brings together literary figures, writers, poets, linguists, and scholars specializing in the use of the Spanish language in Peru. It is a collective member of the Association of Spanish Language Academies.

zh.s: 秘鲁语言学院（西班牙语：Academia Peruana de la Lengua，APL）是一家文化机构，汇集了文学界人士、作家、诗人、语言学家，以及研究秘鲁西班牙语用法的学者。该学院是西班牙语学院协会的集体成员。

en.t: Carnegie Hall (interior pictured) in New York City, built by the philanthropist Andrew Carnegie, officially opened with a concert conducted by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
en.s: Carnegie Hall ( KAR-nig-ee) is a concert venue at 881 Seventh Avenue, between 56th and 57th Streets, in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Designed by architect William Burnet Tuthill and built by its namesake, industrialist and philanthropist Andrew Carnegie, the venue is one of the most prestigious in the world for both classical music and popular music.

zh.t: 卡内基音乐厅（图为内部）在纽约市建成，由慈善家安德鲁·卡内基出资，并在彼得·伊里奇·柴可夫斯基指挥的音乐会上正式开放
zh.s: 卡内基音乐厅位于纽约市曼哈顿中城第七大道 881 号，坐落在第 56 街与第 57 街之间。场馆由建筑师威廉·伯内特·塔特希尔设计，并以实业家、慈善家安德鲁·卡内基的名字命名，是世界上最负盛名的古典音乐和流行音乐演出场地之一。

en.s: Korea University (KU; Korean: 고려대학교) is a private research university in Seoul, South Korea. Korea University also maintains a satellite campus in Sejong City. Established in 1905 as Bosung College by Lee Yong-Ik, a prominent official of the Korean Empire, Korea University is among South Korea's oldest institutions of higher education, and is the nation's first modern private university. It is named after Goguryeo, an ancient Korean kingdom.

zh.s: 高丽大学（KU；韩语：고려대학교）是一所位于韩国首尔的私立研究型大学，在世宗市设有卫星校区。该校于1905年由大韩帝国官员李容翊创办，原名普成专门学校，是韩国历史最悠久的高等教育机构之一，也是韩国第一所现代私立大学。校名取自古代朝鲜王国高句丽。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia on 3, 4 and 5 May 1906. 45,381 people were entitled to vote in the elections. The People's Party won 37 seats, the Croat-Serb Coalition 32 seats, and the Frankists (led by Josip Frank) won 19. On 30 April Nikola Tomašić, leader of the People's Party, renounced his candidature and left politics for a short time.

zh.s: 克罗地亚-斯拉沃尼亚王国于1906年5月3日至5日举行议会选举，共有45,381人具备投票资格。人民党赢得37席，克罗地亚-塞尔维亚联盟赢得32席，约瑟普·弗兰克领导的弗兰克派赢得19席。4月30日，人民党领袖尼古拉·托马希奇放弃参选，并暂时退出政坛。

en.s: The Wolverhampton East by-election of 1908 was held on 5 May 1908. The by-election was held due to the elevation to the peerage of the incumbent Liberal MP, Henry Fowler, who became Viscount Wolverhampton. It was won by the Liberal candidate George Rennie Thorne.

zh.s: 1908年5月5日举行伍尔弗汉普顿东区补选。自由党现任议员亨利·福勒获封贵族、成为伍尔弗汉普顿子爵后，该席位因此出缺。自由党候选人乔治·雷尼·索恩赢得补选。

en.t: The first issue of the Bolshevik newspaper Pravda is published
en.s: Pravda (Russian: Правда, IPA: [ˈpravdə] , lit. 'Truth') is a Russian broadsheet newspaper, and was the official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, when it was one of the most influential papers in the country with a circulation of 11 million. The first issue of Pravda was published in Vienna on October 3, 1908, with Leon Trotsky serving as its editor.

zh.t: 布尔什维克报纸《真理报》创刊
zh.s: 《真理报》（俄语：Правда，意为“真理”）是一份俄罗斯大型报纸。它曾是苏联共产党中央委员会的机关报，也是国内最具影响力的报纸之一，发行量达1100万份。该报首期于1908年10月3日在维也纳出版，由列夫·托洛茨基担任编辑。

en.s: The raid on Glenn Springs occurred on the night of May 5–6, 1916, when Mexican Villistas and Carrancistas attacked the towns of Boquillas and Glenn Springs, Texas. In Glenn Springs, the raiders burned several buildings and fought a three-hour battle with a small force of American soldiers who were stationed there. At the same time, a second party of rebels robbed a general store and a silver mine in Boquillas.

zh.s: 1916年5月5日至6日夜间，墨西哥维利斯塔派和卡兰萨派武装袭击得克萨斯州博基亚斯和格伦斯普林斯镇，格伦斯普林斯突袭由此发生。袭击者在格伦斯普林斯烧毁数栋建筑，并与驻扎当地的一小队美军交战三小时。与此同时，另一支叛军队伍在博基亚斯抢劫了一家杂货店和一座银矿。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 5 May 1917. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and 18 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Nationalist Party of Australia (a result of a merger between the Commonwealth Liberal Party and National Labor Party) led by Prime Minister of Australia Billy Hughes defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by Frank Tudor. Hughes, then a member of the ALP, had become Prime Minister when Andrew Fisher retired in 1915.

zh.s: 1917年5月5日，澳大利亚举行联邦选举。众议院75席和参议院36席中的18席参加改选。时任总理比利·休斯领导的澳大利亚民族主义党击败由弗兰克·都铎领导的反对党澳大利亚工党。民族主义党由联邦自由党和国家工党合并而成。休斯原本是工党成员，在安德鲁·费舍尔于1915年退休后接任总理。

en.s: The 1917 Australian Senate election was held on 5 May 1917 to elect 18 of the 36 senators in the Australian Senate as part of the 1917 federal election. Each state elected three senators to serve a six-year term beginning on 1 July 1917. The election was a landslide victory for the Nationalist Party, who won all 18 contested seats to gain control of the Senate.

zh.s: 1917年5月5日举行澳大利亚参议院选举，改选参议院36席中的18席，是1917年联邦选举的一部分。各州选出3名参议员，任期6年，于1917年7月1日开始。民族主义党大胜，赢得全部18个改选席位，取得参议院控制权。

en.s: The Battle of Seray Mountain (5 May – 13 August 1917) took place between the Assyrian Volunteers, led by Agha Petros and Malik Khoshaba, and Ottoman Empire force led by Halil Kut.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞雷山战役于1917年5月5日至8月13日举行，交战双方是由Agha Petros和Malik Khoshaba率领的亚述志愿军，以及Halil Kut率领的奥斯曼帝国军队。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Ahvenkoski was fought during the Finnish Civil War between 10 April and 5 May 1918 at Ahvenkoski (Swedish: Abborfors; lit. 'perch rapids'), Finland between the German Empire and the Red Guards (Finnish: punakaartit) of the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic, more commonly known as Red Finland. For most of the battle both sides occupied trenches along the Kymi river.

zh.s: 1918年4月10日至5月5日，芬兰内战期间，德意志帝国与芬兰社会主义工人共和国的赤卫队在芬兰阿赫文科斯基交战。阿赫文科斯基的瑞典语名为Abborfors，意为“鲈鱼急流”。战斗的大部分时间里，双方都在基米河沿岸的战壕中作战。

en.s: The 1918 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Légion Saint-Michel field, Paris on May 5, 1918, that saw Olympique de Pantin defeat FC Lyon 3–0 thanks to goals by Émile Fiévet (2) and Louis Darques.

zh.s: 1918年5月5日，法国杯决赛在巴黎的圣米歇尔军团球场举行。潘坦奥林匹克以3比0击败里昂足球俱乐部，埃米尔·菲耶韦打入两球，路易·达尔克斯打入一球。

en.t: Establishment of Communist Youth League of China
en.s: The Communist Youth League of China (CYLC; also known as the Young Communist League of China or simply the Communist Youth League or CYL) is a people's organization in the People's Republic of China for youth between the ages of 14 and 28, run by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The predecessor of the CYLC, the Shanghai Socialist Youth League, was founded in August 1920 by Chen Duxiu and Li Dazhao.

zh.t: 中国共产主义青年团成立
zh.s: 中国共产主义青年团（CYLC；也称中国青年共产主义联盟，或简称共产主义青年团／CYL）是中华人民共和国的人民团体，面向 14 至 28 岁青年，由中国共产党领导。其前身上海社会主义青年团于 1920 年 8 月由陈独秀和李大钊创建。

en.s: The 1925 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 5, 1925. Incumbent George E. Cryer was re-elected, defeating five challengers including judge Benjamin Franklin Bledsoe and Councilmember Miles S. Gregory and winning outright without the need of a general election. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1925年洛杉矶市长选举于5月5日举行。时任市长George E. Cryer成功连任，击败包括法官Benjamin Franklin Bledsoe和市议员Miles S. Gregory在内的五名挑战者，并直接胜选，无需举行第二轮选举。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）在法律上不按党派划分，候选人的党派归属不会出现在选票上。

en.s: The Buckrose by-election, 1926 was a parliamentary by-election for the British House of Commons constituency of Buckrose, Yorkshire on 5 May 1926. This was the first by-election to take place during the General Strike.

zh.s: 1926年5月5日，英国下议院约克郡巴克罗斯选区举行议会补选。这是英国大罢工期间举行的首场补选。

en.s: The 1928 All-Ireland Junior Hurling Championship Final was the ??th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1928 All-Ireland Junior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for teams in Ireland. The match was held on 5 May 1929 between Tipperary and Kilkenny.

zh.t: 1928年全爱尔兰少年级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1928年全爱尔兰少年级曲棍球锦标赛决赛是第??届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1928年该项锦标赛的收官之战。这项比赛由爱尔兰各郡球队参加。决赛于1929年5月5日举行，对阵双方是蒂珀雷里队和基尔肯尼队。

en.s: The 1929 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 5, 1929, that saw SO Montpellier defeat FC Sète 2–0 thanks to goals by Auguste Kramer and Edmond Kramer.

zh.s: 1929年法国杯决赛于1929年5月5日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克球场举行。蒙彼利埃体育俱乐部凭借奥古斯特·克拉默和埃德蒙·克拉默的进球，以2比0击败塞特足球俱乐部。

en.s: An earthquake affected Myanmar on 5 May 1930 with a moment magnitude (Mw) of 7.4. The shock occurred 35 km (22 mi) beneath the surface with a maximum Rossi–Forel intensity of IX (Devastating tremor). The earthquake was the result of rupture along a 131 km (81 mi) segment of the Sagaing Fault—a major strike-slip fault that runs through the country.

zh.s: 1930年5月5日，缅甸发生地震，矩震级（Mw）为7.4。震源深度为地表以下35公里（22英里），最高罗西—福雷尔烈度为IX级（毁灭性震动）。地震由实皆断层一段131公里（81英里）的断裂引发；这条大型走滑断层贯穿缅甸。

en.s: The 1931 Baltimore mayoral election was held on Tuesday May 5. It saw the return of Howard W. Jackson to the mayoralty for a second nonconsecutive term.

zh.s: 1931年巴尔的摩市长选举于5月5日星期二举行。霍华德·W·杰克逊再次当选市长，这是他的第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The 1935 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 5 May 1935, that saw Olympique de Marseille defeat Stade Rennais UC 3–0 thanks to goals by Charles Roviglione, Vilmos Kohut and an own goal by Jean Laurent.

zh.s: 1935年法国杯决赛于1935年5月5日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克球场举行。马赛奥林匹克以3比0击败雷恩大学体育俱乐部，进球者为Charles Roviglione、Vilmos Kohut，另有一粒Jean Laurent的乌龙球。

en.s: The March of the Iron Will (Italian: marcia della ferrea volontà) was an Italian offensive occurring from 26 April to 5 May 1936, during the final days of the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. Its goal was to capture the Ethiopian capital, Addis Ababa, in a show of force for Fascist propaganda. An Italian mechanized column under the command of Pietro Badoglio, Marshal of Italy, advanced from the town of Dessie to take Addis Ababa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 铁意志进军（意大利语：marcia della ferrea volontà）是1936年4月26日至5月5日意大利发动的一次军事攻势，发生在第二次意大利-埃塞俄比亚战争末期。行动目标是攻占埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴，以此为法西斯宣传展示武力。意大利元帅Pietro Badoglio率领一支机械化纵队从德西耶镇出发，向亚的斯亚贝巴推进。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1939–40 Coupe de France football competition concluded with a final at the Parc des Princes stadium in Paris on 5 May 1940 between RC Paris, the winners of the previous competition, and Olympique de Marseille, winners of the 1937–1938 competition. The closing stages of the competition were held against a backdrop of war with Germany, with the invasion of France imminent by the day of the final.

zh.s: 1939—40赛季法国杯于1940年5月5日结束，巴黎王子公园球场举行决赛，由上届冠军巴黎赛车俱乐部对阵1937—38赛季冠军马赛奥林匹克。决赛当天，法国已处于与德国交战的阴影下，德军入侵迫在眉睫。

en.s: The Battle of Hegra Fortress was a 25-day engagement in the 1940 Norwegian campaign which saw a small force of Norwegian volunteers fighting numerically superior German forces from a fortified position. After initial fighting around the Meråker Line railway line, the Norwegians pulled back into Hegra Fortress and held off further German attacks before surrendering on 5 May as one of the last Norwegian units active in southern Norway.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 赫格拉要塞战役是1940年挪威战役期间一场持续25天的战斗。少数挪威志愿军据守要塞，对抗人数占优的德军。默勒克尔铁路线附近最初发生战斗后，挪威军撤入赫格拉要塞，挡住德军后续进攻，最终于5月5日投降。赫格拉要塞是挪威南部最后仍在作战的挪威部队据点之一。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Vinjesvingen was a battle of the Norwegian campaign and took place in May 1940 in the Telemark county, Norway. It became one of the two last strongholds of Norwegian resistance in southern Norway during World War II, the other being Hegra Fortress.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 温耶斯温根战役是挪威战役的一部分，于1940年5月在挪威泰勒马克郡发生。它成为第二次世界大战期间挪威南部抵抗德军的最后两个据点之一，另一个是赫格拉要塞。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: Convoy PQ 15 (26 April – 5 May 1942) was an Arctic convoy sent from Iceland by the Western Allies to aid the Soviet Union (USSR) during the Second World War. The convoy sailed on 26 April 1942, escorted by the western local escort and rendezvoused with the ocean escort on 28 April.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: PQ 15号船队（1942年4月26日至5月5日）是二战期间西方盟国从冰岛出发、援助苏联的北极护航船队。船队于1942年4月26日启航，由西部近岸护航舰护送，并于4月28日与远洋护航舰会合。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Kholm Pocket (German: Kessel von Cholm; Russian: Холмский котёл) was the name given for the encirclement of German troops by the Red Army around Kholm, south of Leningrad, in World War II's the Eastern Front, from 23 January 1942 to 5 May 1942. The pocket was created by the Soviet Toropets–Kholm offensive. A much larger pocket was meanwhile surrounded in Demyansk, about 100 km (62 mi) to the northeast.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 霍尔姆口袋（德语：Kessel von Cholm；俄语：Холмский котёл）是二战东线战场上，红军自1942年1月23日至5月5日在列宁格勒以南的霍尔姆附近包围德军所形成的战场。该包围圈由苏联托罗佩茨—霍尔姆攻势造成。当时，东北约100公里（62英里）处的杰米扬斯克也有一个规模大得多的包围圈。

en.s: The Prague uprising (Czech: Pražské povstání) was an attempt by the Czech resistance to liberate the city of Prague from German occupation during World War II. Events began on May 5, 1945, in the last moments of the war in Europe. The uprising went on until May 8, 1945, ending in a ceasefire between the Czech resistance and the German army, which decided to quit Prague on the same day. Next morning, the Red Army entered the nearly liberated city.

zh.s: 布拉格起义（捷克语：Pražské povstání）是第二次世界大战期间，捷克抵抗力量试图将布拉格从德国占领下解放出来的行动。起义于1945年5月5日、欧洲战事即将结束时爆发，持续至5月8日。捷克抵抗力量与德国军队达成停火，德军同日决定撤出布拉格。次日，红军进入这座几乎已获解放的城市。

en.s: The Battle of Castle Itter was fought on 5 May 1945, in the Austrian village of Itter in the North Tyrol region of the country, during the last days of the European Theater of World War II. Troops of the 23rd Tank Battalion of the 12th Armored Division of the US XXI Corps led by Lieutenant John C.

zh.s: 伊特尔城堡战役于 1945 年 5 月 5 日在奥地利蒂罗尔州北部的伊特尔村发生，处于第二次世界大战欧洲战场的最后阶段。美国第二十三坦克营（隶属第十二装甲师、美国第二十一军）由约翰·C·“杰克”·李少校率领；此外，还有约瑟夫·“塞普”·甘格少校率领的德意志国防军士兵、党卫军上尉库尔特-西格弗里德·施拉德，以及刚获释的法国战俘。他们共同守卫伊特尔城堡，抵御第十七党卫军装甲掷弹兵师的进攻，直到美国第三十六步兵师第一四二步兵团的援军抵达。

en.s: The Bratislava–Brno offensive was an offensive conducted by the Red Army in western Slovak Republic and south Moravia towards the end of World War II. The offensive was held between 25 March and 5 May 1945 using the forces of the 2nd Ukrainian Front to capture the capital of Slovakia, Bratislava, and the capital of Moravia, Brno.

zh.t: 布拉迪斯拉发—布尔诺攻势
zh.s: 布拉迪斯拉发—布尔诺攻势是红军在第二次世界大战末期发动的一场军事行动，战场位于斯洛伐克共和国西部和摩拉维亚南部。行动于1945年3月25日至5月5日进行，由乌克兰第二方面军执行，目标是攻占斯洛伐克首都布拉迪斯拉发和摩拉维亚首府布尔诺。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 5 May 1946. The result was a victory for Mariano Ospina Pérez of the Conservative Party, who received 41.4% of the vote. Opponent Gabriel Turbay of the Liberal Party was also supported by the Social Democratic Party. Two years after the election, Liberal Party candidate Jorge Eliécer Gaitán Ayala was assassinated, sparking the ten-year conflict known as La Violencia.

zh.s: 1946年5月5日，哥伦比亚举行总统选举。保守党候选人马里亚诺·奥斯皮纳·佩雷斯获胜，得票率为41.4%。对手、自由党候选人加夫列尔·图尔拜也得到社会民主党的支持。两年后，自由党候选人豪尔赫·埃利塞尔·盖坦·阿亚拉遇刺身亡，引发了被称为“暴力时期”的十年冲突。

en.s: 1946 Emperor's Cup Final was the 26th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at University of Tokyo Goten-Shita Stadium in Tokyo on May 5, 1946. University of Tokyo LB won the championship.

zh.s: 1946年日本天皇杯决赛是天皇杯第26届决赛。决赛于1946年5月5日在东京的东京大学御殿下球场举行。东京大学LB队夺得冠军。

en.t: Statute of the Council of Europe
en.s: The Statute of the Council of Europe (also known as the Treaty of London (1949)), signed on 5 May 1949, brought into existence the Council of Europe, an international organisation open to all European states devoted to "the pursuit of peace based on justice and international co-operation".

zh.s: 《欧洲委员会规约》又称《1949年伦敦条约》，于1949年5月5日签署，由此成立欧洲委员会。该国际组织面向所有欧洲国家，致力于「以正义和国际合作维护和平」。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 5 May 1953, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election, although only 9 were contested. Only minor changes occurred compared to the previous year, with the overall composition of the council staying the same. The Scottish Self-Government Party contested four seats this election, and the Communist Party contested one.

zh.s: 1953年5月5日，阿伯丁公司举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。该公司37席中的12席参加改选，但只有9席有候选人竞争。与前一年相比，变化很小，议会整体席位分布不变。苏格兰自治党参加其中4席的竞选，共产党参加1席竞选。

en.s: 1953 Emperor's Cup Final was the 33rd final of the Emperor's Cup football competition. The final was played at Nishikyogoku Athletic Stadium in Kyoto on May 5, 1953. All Kwangaku won the championship.

zh.s: 1953年日本天皇杯决赛是天皇杯足球赛第33届决赛。决赛于1953年5月5日在京都西京极综合运动公园陆上竞技场举行。关西学院大学队（All Kwangaku）夺得冠军。

en.t: The General Treaty, by which France, Britain and the United States recognize the sovereignty of West Germany, comes into effect
en.s: The Bonn–Paris conventions were signed in May 1952 and came into force after the 1955 ratification. The conventions put an end to the Allied occupation of West Germany. The delay between the signing and the ratification was due to the French failure to ratify the related treaty on the European Defense Community.

zh.t: 《总条约》生效，法国、英国和美国承认西德主权
zh.s: 《波恩—巴黎公约》于1952年5月签署，在1955年批准后生效。公约结束了盟军对西德的占领。签署和批准之间之所以相隔多年，是因为法国未能批准相关的《欧洲防务共同体条约》。

en.s: The 1956 FA Cup final was the final match of the 1955–56 staging of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup, better known as the FA Cup. The showpiece event was contested between Manchester City and Birmingham City at Wembley Stadium in London on Saturday 5 May 1956.

zh.s: 1956年英格兰足总杯决赛是1955—56赛季英格兰主要足球杯赛——英格兰足球总会挑战杯（通常称为足总杯）的决赛。决赛于1956年5月5日星期六在伦敦温布利球场举行，由曼彻斯特城对阵伯明翰城。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria on 5 May 1957.There were only two candidates, with Adolf Schärf of the Social Democratic Party winning with 51.1% of the vote. Voter turnout was 97.2%.

zh.s: 1957年5月5日，奥地利举行总统选举。两名候选人中，社会民主党人阿道夫·谢尔夫以51.1%的得票率获胜。投票率为97.2%。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iraq on 5 May 1958. Most political parties had been dissolved in 1954, but candidates supportive of the government won 140 of the 145 seats, whilst independent candidates won the remaining five. On 14 July the government was overthrown in a military coup.

zh.s: 1958年5月5日，伊拉克举行议会选举。多数政党在1954年已被解散，支持政府的候选人赢得145席中的140席，独立候选人赢得其余5席。7月14日，政府在军事政变中被推翻。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia in May 1959. In the presidential election, William Tubman of the True Whig Party was re-elected for a fourth term, defeating independent candidate William O. Davies Bright, who received just 55 votes. For the first time, a woman was elected to the legislature, with Ellen Mills Scarbrough winning a seat in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1959年5月举行大选。总统选举中，真辉党候选人威廉·塔布曼连任第四个任期，击败独立候选人威廉·O·戴维斯·布莱特；后者仅获55票。埃伦·米尔斯·斯卡伯勒当选众议院议员，成为首位进入立法机关的女性。

en.s: The 1959 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of J. Harold Grady. Grady unseated incumbent mayor Thomas D'Alesandro Jr. in the Democratic primary, and went on to defeat former mayor and governor Theodore McKeldin in the general election.

zh.s: J. Harold Grady在1959年巴尔的摩市长选举中当选。他在民主党初选中击败时任市长Thomas D'Alesandro Jr.，并在大选中击败前市长兼州长Theodore McKeldin。

en.t: Project Mercury: American astronaut Alan Shepard made a sub-orbital spaceflight on board Freedom 7, becoming the second person to travel into outer space
en.s: Mercury-Redstone 3, or Freedom 7, was the first United States human spaceflight, on May 5, 1961, piloted by astronaut Alan Shepard. It was the first crewed flight of Project Mercury. The project had the ultimate objective of putting an astronaut into orbit around the Earth and returning him safely. Shepard's mission was a 15-minute suborbital flight with the primary objective of demonstrating his ability to withstand the high g-forces of launch and atmospheric re-entry.

zh.t: 水星计划：艾伦·谢泼德乘坐自由7号完成亚轨道飞行，成为第二位进入太空的人
zh.s: 水星-红石3号任务又称自由7号，是美国首次载人航天飞行，于1961年5月5日由宇航员艾伦·谢泼德驾驶。这也是水星计划首次载人飞行。该计划的最终目标是将宇航员送入地球轨道并安全返回。谢泼德此次执行了15分钟的亚轨道飞行，主要目的是验证他能否承受发射和大气层再入时的高重力加速度。

en.s: The 1962 FA Cup final took place on 5 May 1962 at Wembley Stadium and was won by Tottenham Hotspur over Burnley, by a 3–1 scoreline. Due to the lack of passion and excitement, replaced by patience and cautious play, the final was dubbed "The Chessboard Final". Tottenham were the holders, having won the League and FA Cup Double the previous season.

zh.s: 1962年英格兰足总杯决赛于1962年5月5日在温布利球场举行，托特纳姆热刺以3比1击败伯恩利夺冠。由于比赛缺少激情和精彩场面，取而代之的是耐心和谨慎的打法，这场决赛被称为「棋盘决赛」。热刺是卫冕冠军，曾在上一个赛季同时赢得联赛和足总杯冠军。

en.s: General elections were held in Togo on 5 May 1963, alongside a constitutional referendum. It followed a military coup earlier in the year which had ousted (and killed) President Sylvanus Olympio, who had dissolved all political parties except his own Party of Togolese Unity in 1961. Nicolas Grunitzky, who had served as Prime Minister since shortly after the coup was elected President unopposed, whilst in the National Assembly election, a single list of candidates containing members of the Party of Togolese Unity, Juvento, the Democratic Union of the Togolese People and the Togolese People's Movement (all of which had 14 seats) was put forward under the name "Reconciliation and National Union".

zh.s: 1963年5月5日，多哥举行大选，并同时举行宪法公投。此前，当年早些时候发生军事政变，总统西尔瓦努斯·奥林匹奥被推翻并遭杀害。奥林匹奥曾于1961年解散除自己领导的多哥团结党以外的所有政党。政变后不久出任总理的尼古拉·格吕尼茨基在总统选举中无人竞逐，自动当选。国民议会选举中，多哥团结党、尤文托党、多哥人民民主联盟和多哥人民运动各有14席，四党共同组成“和解与民族团结”名单参选。

en.s: An election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 5 May 1964, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. After the election Edinburgh Corporation remained under No Overall Control, composed of 33 Progressives, 31 Labour councillors, and 5 Liberal.

zh.s: 1964年5月5日，爱丁堡公司举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。议会69席中的23席参加改选。选举后，爱丁堡公司仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，议会由33名进步党议员、31名工党议员和5名自由党议员组成。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on May 5, 1964, with runoff elections on June 2, to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1964 Democratic National Convention. Thirty-six delegates were to be elected, four from each of the state's nine old congressional districts, with no at-large delegates to be elected. Nineteen delegate candidates went unopposed.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1964年5月5日，美国阿拉巴马州举行总统初选，并于6月2日举行决选，选出代表阿拉巴马州参加1964年民主党全国代表大会的代表。共选出36名代表，每个州旧国会选区选出4人，不设全州范围的代表。19名代表候选人没有对手。

en.s: The 1964 Alabama Democratic presidential elector primary was held on May 5, 1964, to choose the ten nominees for presidential electors to be listed on the general election ballot under the Democratic party label in the 1964 United States presidential election in Alabama. In 1960, Alabama was the only state where both presidential electors and DNC delegates were elected by popular vote.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉巴马州民主党总统选举人初选
zh.s: 1964年5月5日，阿拉巴马州举行民主党总统选举人初选，选出10名候选人，以民主党名义列入1964年美国总统大选的选票。1960年，阿拉巴马州是唯一一个由选民直接投票选出总统选举人和民主党全国委员会代表的州。

en.s: The 19th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 5-20, 1966. To honour the festival's 20th anniversary, a special prize was given. The Grand Prix du Festival International du Film went to the Signore & Signori by Pietro Germi. The festival opened with Modesty Blaise, directed by Joseph Losey and closed with Faraon, directed by Jerzy Kawalerowicz.

zh.s: 第19届戛纳电影节于1966年5月5日至20日举行。为纪念电影节创办20周年，主办方颁发了特别奖。皮埃特罗·杰尔米执导的《Signore & Signori》获得国际电影节大奖。电影节以约瑟夫·罗西执导的《Modesty Blaise》开幕，以耶日·卡瓦莱罗维奇执导的《法老》闭幕。

en.s: The 1966 European Cup Winners' Cup final was an association football match between Borussia Dortmund of West Germany and Liverpool of England played on 5 May 1966 at Hampden Park, Glasgow, Scotland. It was the final match of the 1965–66 season of Europe's secondary cup competition, the European Cup Winners' Cup. Both sides were competing in their first European final.

zh.s: 1966年5月5日，西德多特蒙德与英格兰利物浦在苏格兰格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场进行欧洲优胜者杯决赛。这是1965—66赛季欧洲次级杯赛欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛。两支球队都是首次参加欧洲赛事决赛。

en.s: An Election to Edinburgh Corporation was held on the 5 May 1970. 23 seats were up for election. Following the election, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 31 Progressives, 21 Labour councillors, 7 SNP councillors, 6 Conservatives, 2 Liberals, and 2 independents. The SNP saw its vote collapse, failing to win a single ward and losing the only ward it was defending.

zh.s: 1970年5月5日举行爱丁堡公司选举，共有23席参加改选。选举后，爱丁堡公司由31名进步党议员、21名工党议员、7名苏格兰民族党议员、6名保守党议员、2名自由党议员和2名独立议员组成。苏格兰民族党的得票大幅下滑，未能赢得任何选区，也失去了唯一一个此前由该党控制的选区。

en.s: The 1970 Alabama Supreme Court election was held on November 3, 1970, to elect the Chief Justice of the Alabama Supreme Court.
en.n: This entry records the primary, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1970 年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1970 年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举于 1970 年 11 月 3 日举行，以选出该州最高法院首席大法官。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的初选日期。

en.s: Alitalia Flight 112 was a scheduled flight from Leonardo da Vinci Airport, in Rome, Italy, to Palermo International Airport in Palermo, Italy, with 115 on board. On 5 May 1972, the Douglas DC-8 crashed into Mount Longa, about 3 miles (4.8 km) southwest of Palermo while on approach to the airport, killing all 115 passengers and crew onboard.

zh.t: 意大利航空112号班机空难
zh.s: 意大利航空112号班机是从意大利罗马列奥纳多·达·芬奇机场飞往巴勒莫国际机场的定期航班，机上共有115人。1972年5月5日，飞机接近机场时在巴勒莫西南约3英里（4.8公里）处撞上隆加山，机上115名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The 1973 FA Cup final was the 92nd final of the FA Cup. It took place on 5 May 1973 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Leeds United, the cup holders and one of the dominant teams in English football at the time, and Sunderland, then playing in the Second Division.

zh.s: 1973年英格兰足总杯决赛是足总杯第92届决赛，于1973年5月5日在温布利球场举行。参赛双方是卫冕冠军利兹联（当时英格兰足坛的强队之一）和当时征战乙级联赛的桑德兰。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France in 1974, following the death of President Georges Pompidou. They went to a second round, and were won by Valéry Giscard d'Estaing by a margin of 1.6%. It is to date the closest presidential election in French history.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乔治·蓬皮杜总统去世后，法国于1974年举行总统选举。选举进入第二轮，瓦莱里·吉斯卡尔·德斯坦以1.6个百分点的优势获胜。截至目前，这是法国历史上差距最小的一次总统选举。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的首轮投票日期。

en.s: The 1976 European Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match between Anderlecht of Belgium and West Ham United of England. The final was held at Heysel Stadium in Brussels on 5 May 1976. It was the final match of the 1975–76 European Cup Winners' Cup tournament and the 16th European Cup Winners' Cup final. Anderlecht won 4–2 against the 1964–65 European Cup Winners' Cup winners to secure their first ever European trophy.

zh.s: 1976年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由比利时安德莱赫特对阵英格兰西汉姆联。决赛于1976年5月5日在布鲁塞尔海瑟尔球场举行，是1975—76赛季欧洲优胜者杯的决赛，也是第16届欧洲优胜者杯决赛。安德莱赫特以4比2击败曾在1964—65赛季夺冠的西汉姆联，首次赢得欧洲赛事冠军。

en.s: Elections to Cornwall County Council were held on 5 May 1977. The whole council of seventy-nine members was up for election and the result was that the Independents, despite losing nine seats, comfortably retained control, winning sixty-four seats. The Conservatives gained eight seats, ending as the second largest political group with thirteen, while Labour remained with only one member, the Ecology Party also won one, and (as in 1973) no one was elected as a representative of the Liberal Party.

zh.s: 1977年5月5日举行康沃尔郡议会选举，全部79席参加改选。独立议员虽然失去9席，仍以64席轻松保住议会控制权。保守党增加8席，以13席成为第二大党团。工党只剩1席，生态党也赢得1席。与1973年一样，没人以自由党代表身份当选。

en.s: Elections to Buckinghamshire County Council were held on Thursday, 5 May 1977, when the whole council of sixty-seven members was up for election. The result was that the Conservatives comfortably retained their control, winning sixty-four seats, a gain of eighteen. The ranks of Labour were decimated, and it ended with only one county councillor, a loss of fifteen, while Independents gained two seats, one Ratepayer and one Independent Conservative, but lost one, a nett gain of one, and the Liberals lost the single seat they had had.

zh.s: 1977年5月5日（星期四）举行白金汉郡议会选举，全部67席参加改选。保守党以64席轻松保住控制权，增加18席。工党遭受重挫，只剩1名郡议会议员，减少15席。独立议员增加2席，其中一席由纳税人党候选人、另一席由独立保守党候选人赢得，但同时失去1席，净增1席。自由党失去了原有的唯一席位。

en.s: Elections to Dorset County Council were held on Thursday, 5 May 1977. The whole council of ninety-one members was up for election and the result was that the Conservatives comfortably retained their control, winning seventy-nine seats, a gain of nineteen, of which nine were from Labour and seven from the Liberals. Labour, the Liberals, and the Independents ended with only four county councillors each.

zh.s: 1977年5月5日（星期四）举行多塞特郡议会选举，全部91席参加改选。保守党以79席轻松保住控制权，增加19席，其中9席来自工党，7席来自自由党。选举后，工党、自由党和独立议员各有4名郡议会议员。

en.s: Tuen Mun Road (Chinese: 屯門公路) is a major expressway in Hong Kong which connects Tuen Mun with Tsuen Wan, within the New Territories. It is part of Hong Kong's Route 9, which circumnavigates the New Territories. Opened in 1978, it was once the major trunk route linking the northwest New Territories to urban Kowloon and is known for its frequent traffic jams and road accidents owing to its early design and heavy usage.

zh.t: 屯门公路这一段于1978年5月5日由麦理浩总督正式开放
zh.s: 屯门公路是香港的一条主要干道，连接新界的屯门和荃湾，属于环绕新界的新界环回公路（9号干线）的一部分。公路于1978年通车，曾是连接新界西北部与九龙市区的主要干道。由于早期设计和车流量大，这条公路经常发生交通拥堵和事故。

en.s: The 1979 Victoria state election, held on Saturday, 5 May 1979, was for the 48th Parliament of Victoria. It was held in the Australian state of Victoria to elect 81 members of the state's Legislative Assembly and 22 members of the 44-member Legislative Council. The incumbent Liberal government led by Rupert Hamer was returned with a significantly reduced majority.

en.s: The Iranian Embassy siege took place from 30 April to 5 May 1980, after a group of six armed men stormed the Iranian embassy on Prince's Gate in South Kensington, London. The gunmen, Iranian Arabs campaigning for the sovereignty of the Khuzestan Province of Iran, took 26 people hostage, including embassy staff, several visitors, and a police officer who had been guarding the embassy.

en.s: The 1981 Bulgarian Cup final was the 41st final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Botev Plovdiv and Pirin Blagoevgrad on 5 May 1981 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. This was Botev's sixth appearance in a final, while it was Pirin's first.

en.s: General elections were held in the Gambia on 4 and 5 May 1982. en.s: The 1983 Bristol City Council election took place on 5 May 1983 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. All seats were up for election, two seats in every ward, due to the introduction of new ward boundaries. Therefore, direct comparisons with previous elections are not possible. Majority is the number of votes separating the 2nd and 3rd candidates. Alliance candidates who were Liberals are described as such. No party had an overall majority; as the largest party the Conservatives formed a minority administration.

en.s: The hijacking of CAAC Flight 296, a Hawker Siddeley Trident 2E aircraft, took place on May 5, 1983. Flight 296 of China Civil Aviation Airlines (CAAC), a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Shenyang Dongta Airport to Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, was hijacked by six Chinese nationals and was forced to land at Camp Page, a US military base in Chuncheon, South Korea.

zh.t: 中国民航296号班机劫持事件
zh.s: 1983年5月5日，一架霍克·西德利三叉戟2E型客机上的中国民航296号班机遭劫持。该航班原定从沈阳东塔机场飞往上海虹桥国际机场，是一班国内定期客运航班。六名中国公民劫持了飞机，迫使其降落在韩国春川的美军基地坎普佩奇。

en.s: The 1984 Copa del Rey final was the 82nd final of the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid, on 5 May 1984, being won by Athletic Bilbao, who beat Barcelona 1–0. The match is well known due to a huge brawl between players at the end of the game which resulted in the multi-month suspension of three players from each side (including Diego Maradona).

en.s: The Tajikistani Civil War was an armed conflict in Tajikistan that began in May 1992 and ended in June 1997. Regional groups from the Garm and Gorno-Badakhshan regions of Tajikistan rose up against the newly formed government of President Rahmon Nabiyev, which was dominated by people from the Khujand and Kulob regions.

en.s: FMW 4th Anniversary Show: Origin was a professional wrestling event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW). The event took place on May 5, 1993 at the Kawasaki Stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. This was the fourth edition of the company's flagship event Anniversary Show, commemorating the fourth anniversary of the company. The main event was a no rope exploding barbed wire time bomb deathmatch between Atsushi Onita and Terry Funk, which Onita won.

zh.s: FMW四周年纪念赛「起源」是由职业摔角联盟Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling（FMW）举办的比赛。赛事于1993年5月5日在日本神奈川县川崎市的川崎球场举行。这是该公司旗舰赛事「周年纪念赛」的第四届，用来纪念公司成立四周年。主赛是无绳、爆炸倒刺铁丝网、定时炸弹式死亡比赛，由大仁田厚对阵Terry Funk，最终大仁田获胜。

en.s: The sixth and last election to Tayside Regional Council was held on 5 May 1994 as part of the wider 1994 Scottish regional elections & British local elections. The election saw the SNP overtaking Labour to become the councils largest party, and following the election the SNP formed a minority administration under Councillor Lena Graham. After 8 weeks however Graham resigned 'for personal reasons' and Ewan Dow took over as council leader. Dow was 22 years old at the time, making him the youngest ever Scottish council leader since records began. Voter turnout was 45.5%.

en.s: The Rotherham by-election was held on 5 May 1994, following the death of Labour Party Member of Parliament for Rotherham Jimmy Boyce. Boyce had won the seat only at the 1992 general election, but it had been continuously held by Labour since 1933, usually with a large majority. As a result, Labour were clear favourites to hold at the by-election. Labour decided to stand Denis MacShane, the director of the European Policy Institute. A former journalist and trade union employee, he had unsuccessfully contested Solihull at the October 1974 general election.

en.s: The 1994 Newham London Borough Council election to the Newham London Borough Council was held on 5 May 1994. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 37.2%. Labour maintained its overwhelming majority.

zh.t: 1994年纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1994年纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举于1994年5月5日举行，改选全体议席。投票率为37.2%。工党继续以明显多数控制议会。

en.s: The 1994 Orkney Islands Council election, the sixth election to Orkney Islands Council, was held on 5 May 1994 as part of the wider 1994 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Independent candidates take all seats available, except for the ward of Kirkwall Pickaquoy, which had no nominations.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会第六届选举于1994年5月5日举行，属于当年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。除柯克沃尔皮克夸伊选区因无人提名而空缺外，独立候选人赢得了所有可竞争席位。

en.s: The 1994 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 5 May 1994. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1990. There was also a second seat up for election in Mobbsbury. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since its creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1994年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1994年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，与其他地方选举同日。通常应改选的三分之一议席本次改选，这些席位上次于1990年改选。莫布斯伯里选区另有一个席位同时改选。工党继续控制议会；自议会1973年成立以来，一直由工党执政。

en.s: The 1994 Peterborough City Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1994年彼得伯勒市议会选举于1994年5月5日举行，选出英格兰彼得伯勒市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Harlow District Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.s: 1994年哈洛区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。工党继续控制议会；自议会1973年成立以来，一直由工党执政。

en.s: The 1994 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1994年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1994年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Basildon District Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1990. The Conservative Party lost control of the council, which fell under no overall control.

zh.s: 1994年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。通常应改选的三分之一议席本次改选，这些席位上次于1990年改选。保守党失去议会控制权，议会转为无人占多数。

en.s: The 1994 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 5 May 1994. The results showed a continued decline for the governing Conservatives — who were now in their 15th successive year of government at Westminster — with the third-placed party, the Liberal Democrats, as the main beneficiaries. The main opposition, the Labour Party, gained 44 seats, bringing their number of councillors to 9,257.

zh.s: 1994年英国地方选举于5月5日星期四举行。结果显示，执政的保守党持续走弱；该党在威斯敏斯特已连续执政15年。排名第三的自由民主党是主要受益者。主要反对党工党增加44席，议员总数达到9,257人。

en.s: The 1994 Fife Regional Council election, the sixth and final election to Fife Regional Council, was held on 5 May 1994 as part of the wider 1994 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Labour maintaining their control of the region's 46 seat council.

zh.s: 法夫地区议会第六届、也是最后一届选举于1994年5月5日举行，属于当年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。工党继续控制这个拥有46个席位的地区议会。

en.s: The 1994 Exeter City Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1994年埃克塞特市议会选举于1994年5月5日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 5 May 1994. Ward changes took place in Barking and Dagenham and Ealing which increased the total number of councillors by 3 from 1,914 to 1,917. All London borough council seats were up for election. The previous Borough elections in London were in 1990.

zh.s: 1994年5月5日星期四，伦敦及英国其他一些地区举行了地方选举。巴金-达格纳姆和伊灵的选区调整使议员总数增加3人，从1,914人增至1,917人。伦敦所有自治市议会席位都在此次选举中改选。伦敦上一次自治市选举于1990年举行。

en.s: The 1994 Cambridge City Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 1994年剑桥市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地区的地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Southend-on-Sea Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 1994年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1994年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会成员。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。

en.s: The 1994 Chester City Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1994年切斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. At the election, the Liberal Democrats won majority control of the council for the first time.

zh.s: 1994年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。自由民主党在此次选举中首次赢得议会多数席位。

en.s: The 1994 Brighton Borough Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Brighton Borough Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1994年布莱顿自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡布莱顿自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 19 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected. The council fell into no overall control with no party having control.

zh.s: 1994年埃平森林区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会成员。此次共有19名议员当选。选举后，议会没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The 1994 Central Regional Council election, the sixth and final election to Central Regional Council, was held on 5 May 1994 as part of the wider 1994 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Labour hold their overall majority, taking 23 out of the 35 available seats.

zh.s: 中央地区议会第六届、也是最后一届选举于1994年5月5日举行，属于当年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。工党保持多数，赢得35个席位中的23席。

en.s: The 1994 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 5 May 1994 to elect members to Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Liberal Democrats gained control of the council from no overall control, becoming the first party other than the Conservatives to control the council since its creation in 1973.

zh.s: 1994年科尔切斯特区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特区议会成员，与英国其他地区的地方选举同日举行。自由民主党从无人占多数的议会中赢得控制权，成为该区议会自1973年成立以来首个控制议会的非保守党。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 5 May 1994. One-third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party retained leadership of the council as a minority administration. As of 2026, this was the last Liverpool City Council election where a Conservative was elected.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1994年5月5日举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选，工党继续以少数派政府形式领导议会。截至2026年，这是利物浦市议会最后一次有保守党候选人当选的选举。

en.s: Elections to Strathclyde Regional Council were held on Thursday 5 May 1994, on the same day as the eight other Scottish regional elections. This was the final election to the regional council which was abolished in 1995 along with the 19 district councils and replaced by 12 unitary authorities following the implementation of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994.

zh.t: 1994年斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会选举
zh.s: 斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会选举于1994年5月5日星期四举行，与苏格兰其他8个地区议会选举同日进行。这是该地区议会的最后一次选举；根据《1994年苏格兰地方政府等法案》实施改革，该议会与19个区议会于1995年撤销，并由12个单一层级地方政府取代。

en.s: Elections to Grampian Regional Council were held on 5 May 1994, on the same day as the other Scottish regional council elections. This was the sixth and final election to the regional council following the implementation of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The election used the 57 electoral divisions (wards) created by the Second Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1992.

zh.s: 格兰扁地区议会选举于1994年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他地区议会选举同日进行。这是根据《1973年苏格兰地方政府法》实施改革后，该地区议会第六次、也是最后一次选举。选举采用1992年第二次法定选区安排审查设立的57个选区（选区）。

en.s: The 1994 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 5 May 1994. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1990. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1994年林肯市议会选举于5月5日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位本次改选，这些席位上次于1990年改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1994 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 5 May 1994, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. There were 16 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. Labour won most votes, but saw no net increase in its number of seats.

zh.t: 1994年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1994年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月5日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会50个席位中有16席改选，为议会通常改选的三分之一。工党得票最多，但席位总数没有净增加。

en.s: Elections to Lewisham London Borough Council were held in May 1994. The whole council was up for election. Lewisham local elections are held every four years, with the next due in 1998.

zh.t: 1994年刘易舍姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 刘易舍姆伦敦自治市议会选举于1994年5月举行，全体议席都要改选。刘易舍姆每四年举行一次地方选举，下一次预定于1998年举行。

en.s: The 1994 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1994 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor plus two bye-elections, one each for St John's and Stoke Park Wards.

zh.t: 1994年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1994年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举采用每年改选三分之一议员的制度，是1994年英国地方选举的一部分。16个选区各选出一名议员，圣约翰和斯托克公园选区各另有一场补选。

en.s: Elections to Lambeth London Borough Council were held in May 1994. Turnout was 43.01%.

zh.t: 1994年兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举于1994年5月举行，投票率为43.01%。

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held in May 1994. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 36.5%.

zh.t: 1994年萨瑟克伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 萨瑟克议会选举于1994年5月举行，全体议席都要改选。投票率为36.5%。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 5 May 1995. One third of the council was up for election.

en.s: FMW 6th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW), taking place on May 5, 1995 at the Kawasaki Stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. This was the sixth edition of the company's flagship event Anniversary Show, commemorating the sixth anniversary of the company and the third consecutive and fourth overall edition of Anniversary Show at Kawasaki Stadium.

zh.s: FMW六周年纪念赛是由职业摔角联盟Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling（FMW）举办的比赛，于1995年5月5日在日本神奈川县川崎市的川崎球场举行。这是该公司旗舰赛事「周年纪念赛」的第六届，用来纪念公司成立六周年；也是该赛事连续第三年、总计第四次在川崎球场举行。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 5 May 1995, with one third of the council up for election. The election resulted in Labour retaining control of the council.

zh.t: 1995年巴恩斯利都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利都会自治市议会选举于1995年5月5日举行，议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: FMW 7th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW), taking place on May 5, 1996 at the Kawasaki Stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. This was the seventh edition of the company's flagship event Anniversary Show, commemorating the seventh anniversary of the company and the fourth consecutive and fifth overall edition of Anniversary Show at Kawasaki Stadium.

zh.s: FMW七周年纪念赛是由职业摔角联盟Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling（FMW）举办的比赛，于1996年5月5日在日本神奈川县川崎市的川崎球场举行。这是该公司旗舰赛事「周年纪念赛」的第七届，用来纪念公司成立七周年；也是该赛事连续第四年、总计第五次在川崎球场举行。

en.s: The 1999 Greek Cup final was the 55th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 5 May 1999 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and Olympiacos. It was Panathinaikos' twenty fifth Greek Cup final and third consecutive in their 91 years of existence and Olympiacos' twenty-eighth Greek Cup final in their 74-year history.

zh.s: 1999年希腊杯决赛是希腊杯第55届决赛，于1999年5月5日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛球队是帕纳辛奈科斯和奥林匹亚科斯。这是帕纳辛奈科斯91年队史上的第25次希腊杯决赛，也是连续第三年进入决赛；奥林匹亚科斯则在其74年队史上第28次参加希腊杯决赛。

en.s: FMW 11th Anniversary Show: Backdraft was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW). The event took place on May 5, 2000 at Komazawa Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan. The event commemorated the eleventh anniversary of FMW. In the main event, Hayabusa defeated ECW Japan member Masato Tanaka. Another important match on the card featured Tetsuhiro Kuroda defend the WEW World Heavyweight Championship against Kodo Fuyuki, with Fuyuki defeating Kuroda to win the title.

zh.s: FMW十一周年纪念赛「逆火」是由职业摔角联盟Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling（FMW）举办的付费观看赛事。赛事于2000年5月5日在日本东京的驹泽体育馆举行，纪念FMW成立十一周年。主赛中，Hayabusa击败了ECW Japan选手田中将斗。另一场重要比赛中，黑田哲弘卫冕WEW世界重量级冠军头衔，对手冬木弘道击败他夺得冠军。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran on 18 February 2000, with a second round on 5 May. The result was a solid victory for 2nd of Khordad Front and its allies, the reformist supporters of President Mohammad Khatami.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伊朗议会选举于2000年2月18日举行，第二轮投票于5月5日进行。结果显示，第二库尔达德阵线及其盟友取得明显胜利；他们是总统穆罕默德·哈塔米的改革派支持者。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的选举日期。

en.s: FMW 12th Anniversary Show: Kawasaki Legend 2001 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW). The event took place on May 5, 2001 at Kawasaki Stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. The event marked the return of FMW to the Kawasaki Stadium since Fall Spectacular in 1997. The event commemorated the twelfth anniversary of the promotion and was the final edition of the Anniversary Show as the promotion closed on February 15, 2002.

zh.s: FMW十二周年纪念赛「川崎传奇2001」是由职业摔角联盟Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling（FMW）举办的付费观看赛事，于2001年5月5日在日本神奈川县川崎市的川崎球场举行。自1997年的「秋季盛典」以来，这是FMW首次重返川崎球场。赛事纪念联盟成立十二周年，也是最后一届周年纪念赛；FMW于2002年2月15日关闭。

en.s: The 2001 Insurrextion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was the second annual Insurrextion and took place on May 5, 2001, at the Earls Court Exhibition Centre in London, England for a second consecutive year. This was the final Insurrextion produced before the promotion introduced the brand extension in March 2002.

zh.s: 2001年《Insurrextion》是美国摔角联盟世界摔角联合会（WWF，现WWE）制作的付费观看赛事，仅在英国播出。这是该赛事第二届年度赛事，于2001年5月5日连续第二年在英格兰伦敦的伯爵宫展览中心举行。这是联盟于2002年3月推出品牌分组制度前制作的最后一届《Insurrextion》。

en.s: The 2001 Coupe de la Ligue final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis, on 5 May 2001, that saw Lyon defeat Monaco 2–1 thanks to goals by Caçapa and Patrick Müller.

zh.s: 2001年法国联赛杯决赛于2001年5月5日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。里昂以2比1击败摩纳哥，进球者为卡萨帕和Patrick Müller。

en.s: The 2001 El Paso mayoral election was held on May 26, 2001, to elect the mayor of El Paso, Texas. It saw the election of Raymond Caballero. Caballero defeated former mayor Larry Francis.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 21 April 2002, with a runoff election between the top two candidates, incumbent Jacques Chirac of the Rally for the Republic and Jean-Marie Le Pen of the National Front, on 5 May. This presidential contest attracted a greater than usual amount of international attention because of candidate Le Pen's unexpected appearance in the runoff election.

zh.s: 法国于2002年4月21日举行首轮总统选举，随后由得票前两名进入第二轮：现任总统、保卫共和联盟候选人雅克·希拉克，以及国民阵线候选人让-马里·勒庞。第二轮于5月5日举行。这次选举受到的国际关注高于往常，因为勒庞意外进入了第二轮。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Niutao constituency in Tuvalu on 5 May 2003. It was triggered by the death of the incumbent MP, Saloa Tauia. Tauia, the Speaker of Parliament, died in February, after having entered Parliament in the July 2002 general election. On the same day, the Nanumea by-election, 2003 was also held, which following the annulment in February of incumbent MP Sio Patiale's election in the July 2002 general election. There are no political parties in Tuvalu, but Patiale and Tauia were both members of prime minister Saufatu Sopoanga's extremely narrow parliamentary majority.

zh.s: 2003年5月5日，图瓦卢纽塔奥选区举行补选，起因是现任议员、议会议长萨洛阿·陶亚于2月去世。陶亚在2002年7月大选后进入议会。同一天，纳努梅阿选区也举行补选；此前该选区现任议员西奥·帕蒂亚莱在2月的大选资格被取消。图瓦卢没有政党，但帕蒂亚莱和陶亚都属于总理索法图·索波安加在议会中仅以微弱优势占多数的阵营。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A by-election was held in the Nanumea constituency in Tuvalu on 5 May 2003. It was triggered by the annulment in February of incumbent MP Sio Patiale's election in the July 2002 general election. Patiale was found by the country's High Court of Tuvalu to have "lodged his nomination papers after the legal deadline", and thus not to have stood lawfully as a candidate in the general election. On the same day the Niutao by-election, 2003 was also held, following the death of the Speaker of Parliament, Saloa Tauia in February.

zh.s: 2003年5月5日，图瓦卢纳努梅阿选区举行补选。此前，现任议员西奥·帕蒂亚莱在2月因提名文件逾期递交，被图瓦卢高等法院裁定未能合法参加2002年7月的大选，原当选资格因此被取消。同一天，纽塔奥选区也举行补选；该选区现任议员、议会议长萨洛阿·陶亚于2月去世。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2003 FA Women's Cup Final was an association football match between Fulham Ladies and Charlton Athletic Women on 5 May 2003 at Selhurst Park in London, England. It was the 33rd final overall of the FA Women's Cup, a cup competition originally organised by the Women's Football Association (WFA) between 1970 and 1993, and by The Football Association (FA) since 1993.

zh.s: 2003年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是一场足球比赛，由富勒姆女队对阵查尔顿竞技女队，于2003年5月5日在英格兰伦敦的塞尔赫斯特公园球场举行。这是英格兰足总女子杯的第33届决赛。该赛事最初由女子足球协会（WFA）于1970年至1993年组织，1993年起由英格兰足球总会（FA）组织。

en.s: Elections for local government were held in the England and Northern Ireland on 5 May 2005 along with the 2005 general election across the entire United Kingdom. In addition, the Isle of Wight held a local referendum on the issue of a directly elected mayor. Despite losing the general election held on the same day, the Conservatives made strong gains at Labour's expense, providing some comfort to the party. Conservative leader Michael Howard resigned soon afterwards and was succeeded by David Cameron, who had a decent platform to build on in his challenge to lead the Conservatives to a general election victory; the party had increased its share of council seats and importantly its share of seats in parliament.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，英格兰和北爱尔兰举行地方选举，并与全英国的大选同日举行。怀特岛还就市长是否应由选民直选举行了地方公投。保守党虽然在同日举行的大选中落败，但在地方选举中从工党手中赢得不少席位，为该党带来一定安慰。保守党领袖迈克尔·霍华德不久后辞职，戴维·卡梅伦接任。保守党议会席位和全国议会席位占比均有所上升，为卡梅伦争取在大选中获胜提供了基础。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Suffolk County Council were held on 5 May 2005. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 2001 reducing the number of seats by 5. The Conservative party gained control of the council from no overall control. The ruling Labour-Liberal Democrat coalition had become increasingly unpopular following a number of significant council tax rises. The opposition Conservatives were successful in highlighting this to their benefit. Both the Liberal Democrats and Labour endured heavy losses to the Conservatives in rural areas, but they performed better in urban Suffolk.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行萨福克郡议会选举，全体议员参加改选。选区边界较2001年上次选举有所调整，席位减少5席。保守党从无单一政党控制的议会中取得控制权。执政的工党—自由民主党联合政府因多次大幅提高市政税而越来越不受欢迎，反对党保守党成功利用这一点争取选民支持。自由民主党和工党在农村地区都大幅失去席位，但在萨福克郡的城市地区表现较好。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: An election to Cambridgeshire County Council took place on 5 May 2005 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2005. The election took place on the same day as the United Kingdom general election, 2005. 69 councillors were elected from 60 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting. New electoral division boundaries were brought in for this election, increasing the number of seats from 59. The Conservative Party retained their majority on the council, while the Labour Party lost all their rural councillors with their representation limited to the city of Cambridge.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行剑桥郡议会选举，是2005年英国地方选举的一部分，也与英国大选同日进行。来自60个选区的69名议员当选，每个选区通过简单多数制选出一至两名郡议员。新的选区边界在本次选举中启用，席位数由59席增加。保守党保住了议会多数。工党失去了所有农村地区议员，议席只留在剑桥市内。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Hertfordshire County Council elections were held on 5 May 2005, with all 77 seats contested. The Conservative Party reinforced its hold on County Hall and only the loss of 2 seats in Dacorum Borough detracted from a strong showing across the County. It maintained a stranglehold on the Eastern part of the County, winning all of the seats in Broxbourne District and East Herts District. The Liberal Democrats made a strong showing in Watford and St Albans District and made gains in Tring Division (Dacorum) and Chells Division (Stevenage) from Conservatives and Labour respectively.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行赫特福德郡议会选举，全部77席参加改选。保守党进一步巩固了对郡议会的控制，仅在达科勒姆自治市失去两席，影响了其在全郡的强势表现。保守党继续牢牢控制郡东部，赢得布鲁克斯本区和东赫特福德区的所有席位。自由民主党在沃特福德和圣奥尔本斯表现强劲，并在特林选区（达科勒姆）和切尔斯选区（史蒂夫尼奇）分别从保守党和工党手中赢得席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 2005 was held on Thursday, 5 May 2005 to elect 646 members to the British House of Commons. The Labour Party under Tony Blair won its third consecutive victory, but its majority now stood at 66 seats compared to the 160-seat majority it had previously held. It remains the last Labour general election victory in the UK. The Labour campaign emphasised a strong economy; however, Blair had suffered a decline in popularity even before the decision to send British troops to invade Iraq in 2003.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日（星期四），英国举行大选，选出646名下议院议员。托尼·布莱尔领导的工党连续第三次获胜，但多数席位从此前的160席降至66席。这也是工党最近一次赢得英国大选。工党竞选主打强劲经济；不过，在2003年决定派兵入侵伊拉克之前，布莱尔的支持率已经开始下滑。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Wiltshire County Council were held on 5 May 2005. The whole council was up for election and the Conservatives held onto control. Most electoral divisions had boundary changes, and several were new, including three new two-member divisions, in Salisbury and Trowbridge. As with other county elections in England, these local elections in Wiltshire took place on the same day as the United Kingdom general election, 2005. The previous Wiltshire Council election, 2001, had also coincided with the 2001 general election.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行威尔特郡议会选举，全体议员参加改选，保守党保住了控制权。多数选区的边界都有调整，其中一些是新设选区，包括索尔兹伯里和特罗布里奇的三个双席选区。与英格兰其他郡议会选举一样，本次威尔特郡地方选举与2005年英国大选同日举行。上一次威尔特郡议会选举在2001年举行，也与当年大选同日进行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mark Curtis Memorial Reunion was a professional wrestling memorial show produced by Pam Hildebrand-Clark, which took place on May 5, 2005 at Freedom Hall in Johnson City, Tennessee. The show was held in memory of wrestling referee Mark Curtis, who died of stomach cancer at his home in Talbott, Tennessee on September 8, 1999, with the proceeds donated to the Children's Miracle Network. Many of the Curtis Comes Home participants returned to take part in the 2005 edition. Like the original event, the Mark Curtis Memorial Reunion served as an unofficial reunion show for Smokey Mountain Wrestling where Curtis had served as head referee.

zh.t: 马克·柯蒂斯纪念重聚赛
zh.s: 马克·柯蒂斯纪念重聚赛是潘·希尔德布兰德-克拉克制作的一场职业摔角纪念演出，于2005年5月5日在田纳西州约翰逊城的自由大厅举行，以纪念1999年9月8日在田纳西州塔尔博特家中因胃癌去世的摔角裁判马克·柯蒂斯。演出收入捐给儿童奇迹网络。多名参加过“柯蒂斯回家”演出的选手回归参加2005年的活动。和最初的活动一样，这场纪念重聚赛也成为烟山摔角联盟的非正式重聚活动；柯蒂斯曾在那里担任首席裁判。

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a county council in the north east of England, were held on 5 May 2005, resulting in a council with Labour members forming a majority.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行诺森伯兰郡议会选举。工党议员取得多数席位。
