en.s: The 2005 Fermanagh District Council election took place on 5 May 2005 to elect members of Fermanagh District Council in Northern Ireland. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，北爱尔兰弗马纳区举行区议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Lincolnshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 5 May 2005, the same day as the general election. The whole council of 77 members was up for election and the election resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council, winning 45 seats.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日（星期四），林肯郡议会举行选举，与英国大选同日进行。全体77席参加改选。保守党赢得45席，保住了议会控制权。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Northamptonshire County Council election took place on 5 May 2005 to elect members of Northamptonshire County Council, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative party gained overall control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，英格兰举行北安普敦郡议会选举，全体议员参加改选。保守党从工党手中取得议会控制权。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Buckinghamshire Council election took place on 5 May 2005 to elect members of Buckinghamshire County Council in England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，英格兰举行白金汉郡议会选举，全体议员参加改选。保守党保住了议会控制权。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Belfast City Council were held on 5 May 2005 on the same day as the other Northern Irish local government elections. The election used nine district electoral areas to elect a total of 51 councillors, most representing the more heavily populated north and west. Sinn Féin emerged as the largest party, and Niall Ó Donnghaile became Lord Mayor.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，贝尔法斯特市议会举行选举，与北爱尔兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举采用9个区级选区，共选出51名议员，多数席位来自人口较多的北部和西部。新芬党成为第一大党，尼尔·奥唐纳盖尔当选市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections for local government were held in Northern Ireland on 5 May 2005, contesting 582 seats in all, along with the 2005 general election across the entire United Kingdom and local elections in England.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，北爱尔兰举行地方政府选举，共改选582席，与全英国大选和英格兰地方选举同日进行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Bristol City Council election took place on 5 May 2005, on the same day as other local elections. The Liberal Democrats made a number of gains and became the largest party on the Council, but failed to gain enough seats to form an overall majority.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行布里斯托市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党赢得多个席位，成为议会第一大党，但席位数不足以取得多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Lancashire County Council were held on 5 May 2005, on the same day as the 2005 general election. Each single-member ward in Lancashire was modified by boundary changes. No elections were held in Blackpool or Blackburn as they are unitary authorities outside of the county boundaries.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日举行兰开夏郡议会选举，与当年英国大选同日进行。兰开夏郡的每个单席选区边界都经过调整。布莱克浦和布莱克本没有举行选举，因为它们是郡界以外的单一管理区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: General elections were held in Dominica on 5 May 2005. The result was a victory for the ruling Dominica Labour Party, which won 12 of the 21 seats in the House of Assembly. The opposition United Workers' Party unsuccessfully made legal challenges to several of the constituency results.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，多米尼克举行大选。执政的多米尼克工党获胜，赢得众议院21席中的12席。反对党联合工人党对多个选区的选举结果提出法律挑战，但未能成功。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 5 May 2005. The whole council was up for election and the result was the Labour Party retaining its control of the council. Boundary changes to the electoral divisions took effect at this election, with the number of seats increased by four.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日（星期四）举行诺丁汉郡议会选举，全体议员参加改选。工党保住了议会控制权。新的选区边界在本次选举中生效，议席增加4席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Cornwall County Council election took place on 5 May 2005, concurrently with other local elections across England and Wales. It was the first election to take place under new ward boundaries, which increased the number of seats from 79 to 82. Cornwall County Council was a county council that covered the majority of the ceremonial county of Cornwall, with the exception of the Isles of Scilly which had an independent local authority.

zh.s: 2005年康沃尔郡议会选举于5月5日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同时进行。这是新选区边界启用后的首次选举，席位从79个增至82个。康沃尔郡议会管辖康沃尔礼仪郡的大部分地区；锡利群岛除外，当地设有独立的地方政府。

en.t: 2005 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on 5 May 2005 and all 59 seats in Scotland were contested. This was the first election to occur under the new boundaries which reduced the number of Scottish seats from 72 to 59. Previously, Scotland had a greater number of MPs per person than the rest of the UK to compensate for its distinct political nature and distance from Westminster.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，英国举行大选，苏格兰的59个席位全部改选。这是新选区边界启用后的首次选举，苏格兰席位从72个减至59个。此前，为反映苏格兰独特的政治情况及其与威斯敏斯特的距离，苏格兰每位议员代表的人口数低于英国其他地区。

en.s: An election to Hampshire County Council took place on 5 May 2005 as part of the 2005 United Kingdom local elections. 78 councillors were elected from 75 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were changed from the previous election, but continued to be used for 2009.

zh.s: 汉普郡郡议会选举于2005年5月5日举行，是当年英国地方选举的一部分。75个选区共选出78名议员，每个选区通过简单多数制选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。选区划分与上届不同，但在2009年选举时仍沿用。

en.t: 2005 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 5 May 2005, the 2005 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 646 members of the House of Commons, including the 18 Northern Ireland seats. 1,139,993 people were eligible to vote, down 51,016 from the 2001 general election. 63.49% of eligible voters turned out (when including spoiled and excluded ballots), down 5.1 percentage points from the last general election.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日，英国大选在北爱尔兰举行，选出下议院全部646名议员，其中包括北爱尔兰的18个席位。共有1,139,993人具备投票资格，比2001年大选减少51,016人。按计入无效及不予计票的选票计算，投票率为63.49%，比上届大选低5.1个百分点。

en.t: 2005 United Kingdom general election in Edinburgh
en.s: These are the results of the 2005 United Kingdom general election in the city of Edinburgh in Scotland. The 2005 general election was held on 5 May 2005 and four constituencies returned Labour Party MPs, with one returning a Liberal Democrat MP. For individual results see results of the 2005 United Kingdom general election.

zh.s: 这是2005年英国大选在苏格兰爱丁堡市的结果。大选于2005年5月5日举行，爱丁堡的四个选区选出工党议员，另一个选区选出自由民主党议员。各选区的具体结果见2005年英国大选结果。

en.t: 2005 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 5 May 2005, the 2005 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 646 members of the House of Commons, with 529 constituencies being in England. The governing Labour Party under Tony Blair won an overall majority of seats for the third successive election. Within England, the opposition Conservative Party received 72,544 more votes than the Labour Party, but Labour won an overall majority of English seats.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日星期四，英国大选在英格兰举行，选出下议院全部646名议员，其中529个选区位于英格兰。托尼·布莱尔领导的执政工党连续第三次赢得议会多数席位。在英格兰，反对党保守党的得票数比工党多72,544票，但工党仍赢得了英格兰大多数议席。

en.s: The 2005 Oxfordshire County Council election took place on 5 May 2005 as part of the 2005 United Kingdom local elections, coinciding with the 2005 United Kingdom general election. 74 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one, two or three county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 2005年牛津郡郡议会选举于5月5日举行，是当年英国地方选举的一部分，也与英国大选同日举行。各选区共选出74名议员；每个选区通过简单多数制选出一至三名郡议员，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to Staffordshire County Council took place on 5 May 2005, the same day as the general election. All 62 seats were up for election.

zh.s: 斯塔福德郡郡议会选举于2005年5月5日举行，与英国大选同日进行。全部62个席位都要改选。

en.t: 2005 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 5 May 2005, the 2005 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 646 members of the House of Commons, with 40 constituencies being in Wales.

zh.s: 2005年5月5日星期四，英国大选在威尔士举行，选出下议院全部646名议员，其中40个选区位于威尔士。

en.s: The 2005 Devon County Council election was an election to Devon County Council which took place on 5 May 2005 as part of the 2005 United Kingdom local elections. 62 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions had been redrawn since the last election in 2001.

zh.s: 2005年德文郡郡议会选举于5月5日举行，是当年英国地方选举的一部分。各选区共选出62名议员；每个选区通过简单多数制选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。选区划分自2001年上届选举后有所调整。

en.s: The 2005 Norfolk County Council election took place on 5 May 2005, coinciding with local elections for all county councils in England and the 2005 general election. It was the first election to be held under new boundaries. The Conservatives were re-elected with a slightly smaller majority of 8 seats and the Liberal Democrats surpassed Labour in vote share (though not in seats).

zh.s: 2005年诺福克郡郡议会选举于5月5日举行，与英格兰各郡议会选举及英国大选同日进行。这是新选区边界启用后的首次选举。保守党再次胜选，多数优势略降至8席；自由民主党的得票率超过工党，但席位数没有超过工党。

en.s: Elections to Cumbria County Council were held on 5 May 2005. This was on the same day as other UK county council elections. The Labour Party remained the largest party with the council staying under no overall control.

zh.s: 坎布里亚郡郡议会选举于2005年5月5日举行，与英国其他郡议会选举同日。工党仍是最大党，但议会没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The 2005 Danish Cup final was the final and deciding match of the 2004–05 Danish Cup. It took place on Thursday 5 May 2005 at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen and saw the Superliga leaders Brøndby IF beat no. 3 in the league FC Midtjylland after extra time. Brøndby have won the Cup on four previous occasions (1989, 1994, 1998 and 2003). Midtjylland have never won the Cup.

zh.s: 2005年丹麦杯决赛是2004—05赛季丹麦杯的决赛，也是决定冠军归属的比赛。比赛于2005年5月5日星期四在哥本哈根帕肯球场举行。丹麦足球超级联赛领头羊布隆德比IF在加时赛后击败排名第三的中日德兰。布隆德比此前曾四次夺冠（1989、1994、1998和2003年），中日德兰则从未赢得过丹麦杯。

en.t: 2005 Dungannon and South Tyrone Borough Council election

en.t: 2006 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2006 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 5 May 2006. This was the first leadership election open to all party members, due to a change in the party's rules proposed by then party leader Luís Marques Mendes, elected in April 2005. Marques Mendes was the sole candidate, thus winning with more than 90% of the votes.

zh.t: 2006年葡萄牙社会民主党领袖选举
zh.s: 葡萄牙社会民主党领袖选举于2006年5月5日举行。这是该党首次向全体党员开放的领袖选举，原因是时任党领袖路易斯·马克斯·门德斯提出修改党章；他于2005年4月当选党领袖。此次只有马克斯·门德斯一人参选，因此他获得超过90%的选票并胜出。

en.t: The government of Sudan signs an accord with the Sudan Liberation Army
en.s: The Sudan Liberation Movement/Army (Arabic: حركة تحرير السودان Ḥarakat Taḥrīr as-Sūdān; abbreviated SLM, SLA, or SLM/A) is a Sudanese rebel group active in Darfur, Sudan. It was founded as the Darfur Liberation Front by members of three indigenous ethnic groups in Darfur: the Fur, the Zaghawa, and the Masalit, among whom were the leaders Abdul Wahid al-Nur of the Fur, Khamis Abakar of the Masalit and Minni Minnawi of the Zaghawa.

zh.t: 苏丹政府与苏丹解放军签署协议
zh.s: 苏丹解放运动／军（阿拉伯语：حركة تحرير السودان，Ḥarakat Taḥrīr as-Sūdān，简称 SLM、SLA 或 SLM/A）是活跃于苏丹达尔富尔地区的苏丹反政府武装组织。该组织由达尔富尔三个原住民族群——富尔人、扎加瓦人和马萨利特人——的成员创建，领袖包括富尔人的阿卜杜勒·瓦希德·努尔、马萨利特人的哈米斯·阿巴卡尔和扎加瓦人的米尼·米纳维。

en.s: Kenya Airways Flight 507 was a scheduled international passenger service between Abidjan, Ivory Coast, and Nairobi, Kenya, with a stopover in Douala, Cameroon, operated by Kenya Airways. On 5 May 2007, the Boeing 737-800 aircraft serving the flight crashed immediately after takeoff from Douala International Airport in Cameroon, killing all 114 occupants onboard.

zh.t: 肯尼亚航空507号班机空难
zh.s: 肯尼亚航空507号班机是由肯尼亚航空运营的定期国际客运航班，往返科特迪瓦阿比让和肯尼亚内罗毕，中途停靠喀麦隆杜阿拉。2007年5月5日，这架波音737-800飞机从杜阿拉国际机场起飞后不久坠毁，机上114人全部遇难。

en.s: The 2007 Greek Cup final was the 63rd final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 5 May 2007 at Panthessaliko Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and AEL. It was Panathinaikos' twenty seventh Greek Cup final in their 99 years of existence and AEL's fourth Greek Cup final in their 43-year history.

zh.s: 2007年希腊杯决赛是希腊杯第63届决赛，于2007年5月5日在潘塞萨利科体育场举行。参赛球队是帕纳辛奈科斯和拉里萨足球俱乐部。这是帕纳辛奈科斯99年队史上的第27次希腊杯决赛，也是连续第三年进入决赛；拉里萨则在其43年队史上第四次参加希腊杯决赛。

en.s: The 2008 FA Women's Cup Final was the 38th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 15th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Leeds United at the City Ground on 5 May 2008.

zh.s: 2008年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该赛事第38届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛决赛。这是英格兰足球总会（FA）直接管理下举行的第15届决赛。阿森纳与利兹联于2008年5月5日在城市球场争夺冠军。

en.s: The 2009 Detroit mayoral special election took place on May 5, 2009, following a primary on February 24, 2009. Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick, who was elected in 2005, resigned after being indicted for obstruction of justice in 2008, elevating City Council President Kenneth Cockrel Jr. as acting Mayor.

zh.s: 2009年底特律市长特别选举于2009年5月5日举行，初选则在2月24日举行。2005年当选的市长Kwame Kilpatrick于2008年因被控妨碍司法公正而辞职，市议会主席Kenneth Cockrel Jr.因此出任代理市长。

en.s: The 2009 Georgian mutiny was a mutiny by a Georgian Army tank battalion based in Mukhrovani, 30 kilometres (19 mi) east of the capital Tbilisi on 5 May 2009. It is not yet known how many soldiers took part. Later that day, the Georgian Ministry of Interior announced that the mutineers had surrendered. Some of its leaders, including the battalion's commander, were arrested; others managed to escape.

zh.s: 2009年格鲁吉亚兵变是格鲁吉亚军队一个坦克营发动的兵变。该营驻扎在穆赫罗瓦尼，距首都第比利斯以东30公里（19英里），兵变于2009年5月5日发生。目前尚不清楚有多少士兵参与。当日稍晚，格鲁吉亚内政部宣布兵变者已投降。部分领导人被捕，其中包括该营营长；其他人则成功逃脱。

en.s: The 2009 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 7 and May 5, 2009, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. Incumbent Mayor Mark Begich had been elected Alaska's junior U.S. Senator in November 2008. Since no candidate reached a 45% plurality needed to win outright, the top-two candidates advanced to a runoff. Fifteen candidates competed, with former State Rep.

zh.s: 2009 年安克雷奇市长选举于 4 月 7 日和 5 月 5 日举行，以选出阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市长。时任市长马克·贝吉奇于 2008 年 11 月当选阿拉斯加州联邦参议员。由于没有候选人获得胜选所需的 45% 最高得票率，得票前两名进入决选。共有 15 名候选人参选，前州众议员埃里克·克罗夫特和前安克雷奇市议员丹·沙利文进入决选；沙利文最终以 57% 得票率胜出。

en.s: The 2009 Flint mayoral special election took place on August 4, 2009, following a primary election on May 5, 2009. Mayor Don Williamson, facing a recall election on February 24, 2009, resigned on February 15, 2009, citing health reasons. Following Williamson's resignation, City Administrator Michael Brown served as acting Mayor until the special election could be held. Brown declined to run in the special election.

en.s: The 2010 Turkish Cup final took place in Şanlıurfa on 5 May 2010. It was the 48th season of the Turkish Cup. Trabzonspor won the match 3–1 against Fenerbahçe.

en.s: The 2010 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Lovech Stadium in Lovech on 5 May 2010, and was contested by Beroe Stara Zagora and Chernomorets Pomorie. The match was won by Beroe Stara Zagora, with Doncho Atanasov scoring the crucial goal in the 92nd minute.

zh.s: 2010年保加利亚杯决赛于2010年5月5日在洛维奇市的洛维奇体育场举行，由旧扎戈拉贝罗队对阵波莫里黑海人队。旧扎戈拉贝罗队获胜，唐乔·阿塔纳索夫在第92分钟打入制胜球。

en.s: The 2010 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2009–10 Coppa Italia, the top cup competition in Italian football. The match was played at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome on 5 May 2010 between Internazionale and Roma and was a repeat of the 2008 Coppa Italia Final. The match was won by Internazionale, who claimed their sixth Coppa Italia title with a lone Diego Milito goal giving them a 1–0 win.

zh.s: 2010年意大利杯决赛是2009—10赛季意大利杯的决赛，该赛事是意大利足球的顶级杯赛。比赛于2010年5月5日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由国际米兰对阵罗马，也是2008年意大利杯决赛的重演。国际米兰凭借迭戈·米利托的一粒进球以1比0获胜，赢得队史第六座意大利杯。

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 5 May 2010. The coalition comprising Mauritius Labour Party under Navin Ramgoolam, the Militant Socialist Movement under Pravind Jugnauth and the Mauritian Social Democrat Party under Xavier-Luc Duval won a majority with 41 seats in the parliament. The Mauritian Militant Movement-led coalition under Paul Berenger finished second with 18 seats.

zh.s: 毛里求斯于2010年5月5日举行大选。由纳文·拉姆古兰领导的毛里求斯工党、普拉温德·贾格纳特领导的激进社会主义运动及泽维尔-吕克·杜瓦尔领导的毛里求斯社会民主党组成的联盟赢得议会多数，共获41席。由保罗·贝朗热领导、以毛里求斯激进运动为首的联盟排名第二，获得18席。

en.s: The Scottish Premier League match between Motherwell and Hibernian on 5 May 2010 set a record as the highest scoring match in the league's history. The match was played at Fir Park in Motherwell and twelve goals were scored in the match, leaving a final scoreline of a 6–6 draw. Hibernian had led the match 4–1 and 6–2 at different points; Hibs goalkeeper Graeme Smith also saved a penalty kick from Ross Forbes when the score was 6–5.

zh.t: 马瑟韦尔6比6战平希伯尼安
zh.s: 2010年5月5日，马瑟韦尔与希伯尼安的苏格兰超级联赛比赛创下联赛历史上进球最多的纪录。比赛在马瑟韦尔的菲尔公园球场举行，双方共打入12球，最终以6比6战平。希伯尼安曾先后以4比1和6比2领先；比分为6比5时，希伯尼安门将Graeme Smith还扑出了Ross Forbes主罚的点球。

en.s: Sheffield City Council elections took place on 5 May 2011. There were 28 seats up for election, one third of the council. The last election left the council with no overall control. Since the previous election, Liberal Democrat councillor Ben Curran, and Lib Dem-turned-independent Frank Taylor had defected to Labour leaving both parties equal at 41 councillors each. This election saw Labour regain control of the council that they lost in 2006, with nine gains from the Lib Dems. Overall turnout was 41.8%. Councillors elected in Sheffield Council election, 2007 defended their seats this year.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日举行谢菲尔德市议会选举，共有28席参加改选，约为议会三分之一席位。上次选举后，议会没有任何政党取得过半席位。此后，自由民主党议员本·柯伦和曾是自由民主党议员的弗兰克·泰勒退出原党加入工党，工党和自由民主党因此各有41名议员。本次选举中，工党从自由民主党手中赢得9席，重新取得议会控制权；工党于2006年失去控制权。投票率为41.8%。2007年当选的议员本次参加连任竞选。

en.s: Elections to Reading Borough Council took place on Thursday 5 May 2011. There were 15 seats up for election, one third of the council. The election meant that the council continued to have no overall control but a Labour led minority administration replaced the previous Conservative Liberal Democrat coalition. The posts of leader of the council and mayor were filled at a meeting of the council on 25 May 2011. Labour member Deborah Edwards was elected mayor on the casting vote of outgoing mayor, Gul Khan. Councillor Edwards then used her casting vote in favour of the new Leader of the council, Jo Lovelock.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日（星期四）举行雷丁自治市议会选举，改选15席，即议会三分之一席位。选举后议会仍没有任何政党取得过半席位，但工党少数派政府取代了此前的保守党—自由民主党联合政府。2011年5月25日，议会会议选出议会领袖和市长。工党议员黛博拉·爱德华兹在即将卸任的市长古尔·汗投下决定票后当选市长，随后又投下决定票，支持乔·洛夫洛克担任新任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2011 elections to Nottingham City Council were held on 5 May 2011 to elect all 55 members to the Council. The previous election was held in 2007 and the results were: Labour 42, Conservatives 7, Liberal Democrats 6. At the time of the 2011 election one Labour councillor, Mick Newton, had left the party and was an independent councillor. This left Labour with 41 councillors at the time of the election. No ward boundary changes took place between the 2007 and 2011 elections. The result of the election was notable for completely wiping-out the Liberal Democrats in Nottingham.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日举行诺丁汉市议会选举，选出全部55名议员。上一次选举于2007年举行，当时工党获42席、保守党获7席、自由民主党获6席。2011年选举时，一名工党议员米克·牛顿已经退党，成为独立议员，工党当时有41名议员。2007年至2011年间选区边界没有变化。本次选举中，自由民主党在诺丁汉失去了全部议席。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 5 May 2011, along with the United Kingdom Alternative Vote referendum, 2011. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2015. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, managing to win every seat contested. Overall turnout was a comparatively high 31.6%, although much down on the previous year's general election turnout of 50.9%. Councillors elected in 2007 were defending their seats this year, and vote share changes are compared on this basis.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日举行曼彻斯特市议会选举，并与2011年英国替代投票制公投同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，当选议员任期四年，至2015年届满。工党保住了议会控制权，并赢得所有参加改选的席位。投票率为31.6%，比前一年大选的50.9%明显低。2007年当选的议员本次参加连任竞选，得票占比变化也以他们上届的结果为比较基准。

en.s: The elections to South Norfolk District Council were held on Thursday 5 May 2011 along with various other local elections around England, elections to the Scottish Parliament, National Assembly of Wales and Northern Ireland Assembly, and a referendum on whether to adopt the Alternative Vote electoral system for elections to the House of Commons. All 46 council seats were up for election. The previous council was controlled by the Conservatives, with the Liberal Democrats being the only opposition. Both main parties had websites detailing their local manifesto pledges: Conservative pledges and record; Liberal Democrat manifesto and candidates.

en.s: The 2011 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 5 May 2011. In England, direct elections were held in all 36 Metropolitan boroughs, 194 Second-tier district authorities, 49 unitary authorities and various mayoral posts, meaning local elections took place in all parts of England with the exception of seven unitary authorities (Cornwall, Durham, Northumberland, Isles of Scilly, Shropshire, the Isle of Wight and Wiltshire), and seven districts and boroughs (Adur, Cheltenham, Fareham, Gosport, Hastings, Nuneaton and Bedworth and Oxford). For the majority of English districts and the 25 unitary authorities that are elected "all out" these were the first elections since 2007.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日（星期四），英国举行地方选举。在英格兰，36个都市自治市、194个第二级区级地方政府、49个单一管理区和多个直选市长职位举行选举。除康沃尔、达勒姆、诺森伯兰、锡利群岛、什罗普郡、怀特岛和威尔特郡这7个单一管理区，以及阿杜尔、切尔滕纳姆、费勒姆、戈斯波特、黑斯廷斯、纳尼顿和贝德沃思、牛津这7个区和自治市外，英格兰各地都举行了地方选举。英格兰大多数区级地方政府，以及25个实行全体改选的单一管理区，自2007年以来首次举行选举。

en.s: The National Assembly for Wales election 2011 was an election for the National Assembly. The poll was held on Thursday, 5 May 2011 and decided the incumbency for all the assembly's seats. It was the fourth election for seats in the National Assembly for Wales (previous elections having been held in 1999, 2003 and 2007), and the second election taken under the rules of the Government of Wales Act 2006. The election resulted in gains for the incumbent Welsh Labour Party, which gained four seats compared to the previous election and now has 30 seats, exactly half of the Assembly.

zh.s: 2011年威尔士国民议会选举于5月5日（星期四）举行，选出国民议会全部议员。这是国民议会的第四次选举，此前分别于1999年、2003年和2007年举行；也是《2006年威尔士政府法》实施后的第二次选举。执政的威尔士工党增加4席，获得30席，正好占议会席位的一半。

en.s: The 2011 Scottish Parliament election was held on Thursday, 5 May 2011 to elect 129 members to the Scottish Parliament. The election delivered the first majority government since the opening of Holyrood, a remarkable feat as the mixed member proportional representation system used to elect MSPs was, according to Jack McConnell, originally implemented to prevent any party achieving an overall parliamentary majority. The SNP won 69 seats, the most the party has ever held at either a Holyrood or Westminster election, allowing leader Alex Salmond to remain First Minister of Scotland.

zh.s: 2011年苏格兰议会选举于5月5日（星期四）举行，选出129名议员。苏格兰议会成立以来首次出现多数党政府，这一结果相当罕见，因为议员选举采用混合成员比例代表制。该制度最初据杰克·麦康奈尔所说，是为了防止任何政党在议会取得多数。苏格兰民族党赢得69席，创下该党在苏格兰议会或英国议会选举中的最高席位数，使党领袖亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德得以继续担任苏格兰首席部长。

en.s: An election for the whole of Luton Borough Council (a unitary authority) was held on 5 May 2011. The Labour Party strengthened its control of the council, mainly at the expense of the Liberal Democrats, winning three-quarters of the seats (albeit with less than half of the votes cast). The Liberal Democrats were marginally outvoted by the Conservatives (see table, below) but won twice as many seats, probably due to not putting up candidates for all available seats (only Labour and the Conservatives had the maximum number of candidates).

en.s: The 2011 Bristol City Council elections were held on Thursday 5 May 2011, for 24 seats, that being one third of the total number of councillors. The Liberal Democrats, who had won overall control of the council in 2009 and increased their majority in 2010, experienced a drop in support and lost 5 seats; 4 to the Labour Party and 1 to the Green Party, which gained its second ever council seat in Bristol. This meant that the Lib Dems no longer had a majority on the council. However, they continued to run the council, relying on opposition groups to vote through any proposal.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日（星期四），布里斯托市议会选举改选24席，即议会三分之一席位。自由民主党于2009年取得议会控制权，并在2010年扩大多数，但本次支持率下滑，失去5席，其中4席被工党赢得，1席被绿党赢得。绿党因此首次在布里斯托市议会取得第二个席位。自由民主党失去多数席位，但继续执政，并依赖反对党团投票支持议案。

en.s: Elections to City of York Council were held on Thursday 5 May 2011. The whole council was up for election. The vote took place alongside the United Kingdom Alternative Vote referendum, 2011. The Labour Party gained overall control of the council from no overall control. Labour had previously won a majority of seats on the new York unitary council in 1995 and again in 1999. The Liberal Democrats had controlled the council outright since 2003 and led a minority administration since the 2007 election. Andrew Waller, leader of the Liberal Democrats group and former leader of the Council, was not reelected.

en.s: Elections for local government were held in Northern Ireland on Thursday 5 May 2011, contesting 582 seats in all. European Union and Commonwealth citizens who were aged 18 or over on election day were entitled to vote. The deadline for voters to register to vote in the elections was midnight on Thursday 14 April 2011. All voters were required to present one piece of photographic ID in order to cast a vote at the polling station – accepted forms of ID are an electoral identity card, a photographic NI or GB driving licence, a European Union member-state passport, a Translink 60+ SmartPass, a Translink Senior SmartPass, a Translink Blind Person’s SmartPass or a Translink War Disabled SmartPass.

zh.s: 2011年5月5日（星期四），北爱尔兰举行地方政府选举，共改选582席。选举日年满18岁或以上的欧盟和英联邦公民有权投票。选民登记截止时间为2011年4月14日（星期四）午夜。所有选民在投票站都必须出示一份带照片的身份证件。可接受的证件包括选民身份证、带照片的北爱尔兰或英国驾驶执照、欧盟成员国护照、Translink 60岁以上智能卡、长者智能卡、视障人士智能卡或战争伤残人士智能卡。

en.t: Brighton and Hove City Council election, 2011
en.s: Elections to Brighton and Hove City Council were held on 5 May 2011, in line with other local elections in the United Kingdom. The whole council, a unitary authority, was up for election with 54 councillors elected from 21 wards. The Green Party made significant gains, overtaking the Conservatives to become the largest party with 23 seats, the largest Green group on any council. The Greens gained seats at the expense of all three other parties, taking the only ward previously in Liberal Democrat hands. The Conservatives lost not only to the Greens but to Labour Co-op candidates in different parts of the city.

en.t: 2011 Weymouth and Portland Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Weymouth and Portland Borough Council were held on 5 May 2011, alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Twelve seats (one-third) of the council was up for election. The council remained in no overall control, with the Conservatives as the largest party.

zh.t: 2011年韦茅斯和波特兰自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦茅斯和波特兰自治市议会选举于2011年5月5日举行，与英国其他地区的地方选举同时进行。议会36个席位中的12席（三分之一）改选。选举后议会仍无人占多数，保守党是最大党。

en.s: The 2011 Canterbury City Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of the Canterbury City Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 2011年坎特伯雷市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡坎特伯雷市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2011 Chichester District Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Chichester District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2011年奇切斯特区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰奇切斯特区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2011 Plymouth City Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members to Plymouth City Council in England. One third of the council was up for election, in addition to a by-election, making twenty seats in total. The previous election produced a majority for the Conservative Party. The election resulted in Labour gaining 5 seats with Conservatives retaining control.

zh.s: 2011年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会成员。通常应改选的三分之一席位加上一场补选，共有20席改选。上届选举后保守党占多数。本次选举中工党增加5席，保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2011 elections for the whole of Telford and Wrekin Council took place on 5 May 2011. 54 councillors were elected in 33 wards and the Labour Party took control from the Conservatives. There were no boundary changes taking effect at this election.

zh.t: 2011年特尔福德和雷金议会选举
zh.s: 特尔福德和雷金议会全体席位的选举于2011年5月5日举行。33个选区共选出54名议员，工党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。此次选举没有实施选区边界调整。

en.s: The 2011 Exeter City Council election took place on 5 May 2011, to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. The election was held concurrently with other local elections in England. One third of the council was up for election; the seats up for election were last contested in 2007. The council remained under no overall control with the Labour Party as the largest party.

zh.s: 2011年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同时进行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位本次改选，这些席位上次于2007年改选。选举后议会仍无人占多数，工党是最大党。

en.s: The 2011 Winchester Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Winchester City Council in Hampshire, England. One third of the council was up for election. The Conservatives won 11 seats, the Liberal Democrats 6, and Labour and Independents one each.

zh.s: 2011年温彻斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡温彻斯特市议会成员。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。保守党赢得11席，自由民主党6席，工党和独立候选人各赢得1席。

en.s: The 2011 Horsham District Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections and the 2011 United Kingdom Alternative Vote referendum. The Conservatives increased their majority on the council to 12, winning a total of 34 seats.

zh.s: 2011年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会成员，与其他地方选举及2011年英国替代投票制公投同日举行。保守党扩大了在议会中的多数优势，增加到12席，席位总数达到34席。

en.s: The 2011 Breckland District Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2011年布雷克兰区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布雷克兰区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to South Hams District Council took place on 5 May 2011, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections and the Alternative Vote referendum. 27 of the 30 wards were up for election, each with either 1,2 or 3 councillors to be elected. The number of seats up for election in each ward is indicated by the number in the brackets following the ward name. 37 of the 40 councillors elected in 2007 defend their seats in this year.

zh.s: 南哈姆斯区议会选举于2011年5月5日举行，与英国其他地方选举及替代投票制公投同日进行。30个选区中有27个改选，每个选区选出1至3名议员。各选区的改选席位数标在选区名称后的括号内。2007年当选的40名议员中，有37人此次竞选连任。

en.s: The 2011 Gloucester City Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Gloucester City Council in England. There were 11 seats for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council from no overall control. Paul James, who had been serving as leader of the council since 2007 running a Conservative minority administration, continued to serve as leader but with his party having a majority.

zh.s: 2011年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会成员。共有11席改选，保守党从无人占多数的议会中赢得控制权。Paul James自2007年以来一直担任议会领袖，并领导保守党少数派政府；选举后他继续担任领袖，保守党则取得多数席位。

en.s: Elections to Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council took place on Thursday 5 May 2011. There were 17 seats up for election, one third of the council. After the election the council continued to have no overall control and continue to be run by a coalition between the Labour Party and the Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2011年卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举于2011年5月5日星期四举行，共有17席改选，为议会席位的三分之一。选举后议会仍无人占多数，继续由工党和自由民主党组建联合政府。

en.s: The 2011 Leicester City Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Leicester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and the first election for the directly elected Mayor of Leicester.

zh.s: 2011年莱斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰莱斯特市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，也是莱斯特首次举行直选市长选举。

en.s: Elections for Ipswich Borough Council were held on Thursday 5 May 2011. One third of the seats were up for election and the Labour Party gained control of the council, which had previously been run under by a Conservative – Liberal Democrat coalition since 2004.

zh.t: 2011年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举于2011年5月5日星期四举行，通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。工党赢得议会控制权。此前，自2004年以来，议会一直由保守党和自由民主党组成的联合政府执政。

en.s: The 2011 Newcastle City Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect one third of the members of Newcastle City Council in England. The elections took place on the same day as other local elections. The result saw the Labour Party gain 12 seats from the Liberal Democrats, taking control of the council for the first time in seven years.

zh.s: 2011年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰纽卡斯尔市议会三分之一的席位。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。工党从自由民主党手中赢得12席，并在七年来首次取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2011 Corby Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Corby Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other UK local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since 1979.

zh.s: 2011年科比自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰科比自治市议会成员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续控制议会；自1979年以来，该议会一直由工党执政。

en.s: The 2011 New Forest District Council election took place on 5 May 2011 to elect members to the New Forest District Council, on the same day as other local elections. The election saw the Conservatives gain eight seats from the Liberal Democrats, increasing their majority.

zh.s: 2011年新森林区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出新森林区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。保守党从自由民主党手中赢得8席，扩大了多数优势。

en.s: The 2011 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2011, to elect all 42 councillors in 18 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections in England as part of the 2011 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.t: 2011年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2011年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会全部42名议员，涉及18个选区。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行，是2011年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2011 Epping Forest District Council election was held on 5 May 2011 to elect members of Epping Forest Council in England as part of the wider local elections in England and Northern Ireland. One-third of the seats were up for election. No vote was held in Buckhurst Hill East, Chigwell Row, Chigwell Village, High Ongar, Willingale and The Rodings, the Loughton wards, Moreton and Fyfield, Passingford or Theydon Bois.

zh.s: 2011年埃平森林区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会成员，是英格兰和北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。巴克赫斯特希尔东、奇格韦尔罗、奇格韦尔村、高昂加、威灵盖尔和罗丁、劳顿各选区、莫顿和菲尔德、帕辛福德以及西登博伊斯均未举行投票。

zh.s: UFC on Fox：迪亚兹对阵米勒，也称UFC on Fox 3，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2012年5月5日在新泽西州东卢瑟福的IZOD中心举行。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 5 May 2012. The two seats up for election were Hobart, held by retiring Labor MLC Doug Parkinson, and Western Tiers, held by independent MLC Greg Hall. These seats were last contested (under different names) in 2006.

zh.t: 2012年塔斯马尼亚立法会周期性选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会周期性选举于2012年5月5日举行。此次改选两个席位：霍巴特选区席位由即将退休的工党立法会成员Doug Parkinson担任，西部高原选区席位由独立议员Greg Hall担任。这两个席位上次改选是在2006年，当时选区名称不同。

en.s: The 2012 FA Cup final was a football match between Chelsea and Liverpool on 5 May 2012. It was the final match of the 2011–12 FA Cup, the 131st season of the world's oldest football knockout competition, the FA Cup. Chelsea were participating in their eleventh final, they had previously won six and lost four. Liverpool were appearing in their fourteenth final, they had won seven times and lost six.

zh.s: 2012年英格兰足总杯决赛于2012年5月5日举行，由切尔西对阵利物浦，是2011—12赛季足总杯的决赛，也是这项世界上历史最悠久的足球淘汰赛第131个赛季的决赛。切尔西第11次进入决赛，此前6次夺冠、4次失利；利物浦第14次进入决赛，此前7次夺冠、6次失利。

en.s: The Fourteenth legislative assembly election was held on 5 May 2013 to elect members from 223 constituencies in the Indian state of Karnataka. Five major political parties contested the election: Indian National Congress (INC), Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Janata Dal (Secular) (JD(S)), B. S. Yeddyurappa's Karnataka Janata Paksha (KJP) and B. Sriramulu's Badavara Shramikara Raitara Congress Party (BSRCP). Though Karnataka has 224 assembly constituencies, elections were held only for 223 seats. The election for the Piriyapatna constituency was postponed to 28 May 2013 due to the death of the BJP candidate for the seat. The voter turnout in the state was 70.23%.

zh.t: 2013年卡纳塔克邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2013年5月5日，印度卡纳塔克邦举行第十四届立法议会选举，选出223个选区的议员。五个主要政党参选：印度国民大会党、印度人民党、人民党（世俗派）、B·S·耶迪尤拉帕领导的卡纳塔克人民党，以及B·斯里拉穆卢领导的贫苦劳动农民大会党。卡纳塔克邦共有224个议席，但皮里亚帕特纳选区的印度人民党候选人去世，该选区选举延期至2013年5月28日举行。全邦投票率为70.23%。

en.s: General elections were held in Malaysia on Sunday, 5 May 2013 for members of the 13th Parliament. State elections also took place in 505 state constituencies in 12 out of 13 states (excluding Sarawak) on the same day. The incumbent right-wing Barisan Nasional led by Prime Minister Najib Razak won a second term against the opposition centre-left Pakatan Rakyat led by Opposition Leader Anwar Ibrahim, after Barisan Nasional formed a majority government at a federal level.

zh.s: 2013年5月5日（星期日），马来西亚举行大选，选出第13届国会议员。同日，马来西亚13个州中的12个州举行州选举，共改选505个州议会席位，砂拉越除外。总理纳吉·拉扎克领导的执政右翼国民阵线击败反对党领袖安瓦尔·易卜拉欣领导的中左翼人民联盟，再次当选执政，并在联邦层面组成多数派政府。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2013 Sabah state election was held on Sunday, 5 May 2013 concurrently with the 13th Malaysian general election. 60 state seats were contested to elect state legislature in the Malaysian state of Sabah. This was the 12th state election in Sabah. The state legislative assembly was dissolved on 3 April 2013 following the announcement by Najib Razak to dissolve the federal Parliament earlier on the same day.

zh.s: 2013年5月5日（星期日），沙巴州举行选举，与马来西亚第13届大选同日进行。州议会60席参加改选。这是沙巴第12次州选举。纳吉·拉扎克同日宣布解散联邦议会后，沙巴州议会于2013年4月3日解散。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Yerevan City Council elections was held on May 5, 2013. The Republican Party of Armenia won 56% of the total vote, Prosperous Armenia had 23%, while Barev Yerevan won over 8%. The opposition parties and the local observers denounced the elections as "unfair".

zh.s: 2013年5月5日举行埃里温市议会选举。亚美尼亚共和党赢得56%的选票，繁荣亚美尼亚党获23%，你好埃里温联盟超过8%。反对党和当地观察员谴责选举“不公”。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: State elections were held in all states and territories in Malaysia except Sarawak on 5 May 2013, alongside general elections. Although the Pakatan Rakyat alliance received over 50% of the vote across the 12 states and territories where elections took place, the Barisan Nasional won the most seats, emerging as the largest faction in all states and territories except Kelantan, Penang and Selangor.

zh.s: 2013年5月5日，马来西亚除砂拉越以外的所有州和联邦直辖区举行州选举，与大选同期进行。人民联盟在举行选举的12个州和直辖区合计得票超过50%，但国民阵线赢得最多席位，并在除吉兰丹、槟城和雪兰莪以外的所有州和直辖区成为第一大党团。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2013 Conference Premier play-off final, known as the 2013 Blue Square Bet Premier play-off final for sponsorship purposes, was a football match between Wrexham and Newport County on 5 May 2013 at Wembley Stadium in London. It was the eleventh Conference Premier play-off final and the first ever Wembley Final to feature two teams from Wales.

zh.t: 2013年英格兰足球议会全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2013年英格兰足球议会全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因又称「2013年Blue Square Bet英格兰足球议会全国联赛附加赛决赛」，是一场由雷克瑟姆对阵纽波特郡的足球比赛，于2013年5月5日在伦敦温布利球场举行。这是第11届全国联赛升级附加赛决赛，也是温布利球场首次举办由两支威尔士球队参加的决赛。

en.s: The 2013 Salzburg state election was held on 5 May 2013 to elect the members of the Landtag of Salzburg. The governing coalition of the Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ) and Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) suffered huge losses. The SPÖ lost suffered a swing of almost 16 percentage points, while the ÖVP lost 7.5; despite its losses, the latter became the largest party in the Landtag.

zh.s: 2013年萨尔茨堡州选举于5月5日举行，选出萨尔茨堡州议会议员。由奥地利社会民主党（SPÖ）和奥地利人民党（ÖVP）组成的执政联盟遭遇惨败。社民党得票率下跌近16个百分点，人民党下跌7.5个百分点；尽管得票下滑，人民党仍成为州议会第一大党。

en.s: The 13th Penang election was held on 5 May 2013. Polling took place in 40 constituencies throughout the State of Penang, with each electing a State Assemblyman to the Penang State Legislative Assembly. The election was conducted by the Malaysian Election Commission. The legislative body had been dissolved on 5 April by the Governor of Penang, Abdul Rahman Abbas, on the advice of the incumbent Chief Minister, Lim Guan Eng, who also led the state's ruling coalition, Pakatan Rakyat (PR).

zh.s: 第13届槟城州选举于2013年5月5日举行。槟城州40个选区进行投票，各选区选出一名议员进入槟城州立法议会。选举由马来西亚选举委员会负责。槟城州元首阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿巴斯应时任首席部长林冠英的建议，于4月5日解散州议会；林冠英也领导执政联盟人民联盟（PR）。

en.s: The 13th Kelantan state election were held on 5 May 2013. Polling took place in 45 constituencies throughout the Malaysian state of Kelantan, with each electing a State Assemblyman to the Kelantan State Legislative Assembly. The election was conducted by the Malaysian Election Commission. The state election was held concurrently with the 2013 Malaysian general election. Parti Islam Se-Malaysia (PAS), the governing party of the state, won the election with 32 seats.

zh.s: 第13届吉兰丹州选举于2013年5月5日举行。马来西亚吉兰丹州45个选区进行投票，各选区选出一名州议员进入吉兰丹州立法议会。选举由马来西亚选举委员会负责，并与2013年马来西亚大选同时举行。州执政党马来西亚伊斯兰党（PAS）赢得32席，胜出选举。

en.s: The 13th Selangor state election was held on 5 May 2013. The Selangor State Legislative Assembly would automatically dissolve on 22 April 2013, the fifth anniversary of the first sitting, and elections must be held within sixty days (two months) of the dissolution; on or before 22 June 2013, with the date to be decided by the Election Commission of Malaysia, unless dissolved prior to that date by the Head of State, Sultan of Selangor on the advice of the Head of Government, Menteri Besar of Selangor.

zh.s: 第13届雪兰莪州选举于2013年5月5日举行。雪兰莪州立法议会将于2013年4月22日自动解散，即上届首次开会五周年之日；解散后必须在60天（两个月）内举行选举，也就是不晚于6月22日。具体日期由马来西亚选举委员会决定；若雪兰莪州苏丹应政府首脑、州务大臣的建议提前解散议会，则另作安排。

en.s: The 13th Kedah state election was held on 5 May 2013. Polling took place in 36 constituencies throughout the Malaysian state of Kedah, with each electing a State Assemblyman to the Kedah State Legislative Assembly. The election was conducted by the Malaysian Election Commission. The state election was held concurrently with the 2013 Malaysian general election.

zh.s: 第13届吉打州选举于2013年5月5日举行。马来西亚吉打州36个选区进行投票，各选区选出一名州议员进入吉打州立法议会。选举由马来西亚选举委员会负责，并与2013年马来西亚大选同时举行。

en.s: The 13th Perak state election was held on 5 May 2013. Polling took place in 59 constituencies throughout the State of Perak, with each electing a State Assemblyman to the Perak State Legislative Assembly. The election was conducted by the Malaysian Election Commission. The state election was held concurrently with the 2013 Malaysian general election.

zh.s: 第13届霹雳州选举于2013年5月5日举行。霹雳州59个选区进行投票，各选区选出一名州议员进入霹雳州立法议会。选举由马来西亚选举委员会负责，并与2013年马来西亚大选同时举行。

en.s: The 2013 Hazfi Cup final was the 26th final since 1975. The match was the Iran's El-classico between Persepolis and Sepahan. This was the clubs' second meeting in the final where Sepahan won 4–2 over Persepolis in the penalties in 2006. The match was also the last match of Persepolis captain Mehdi Mahdavikia, a former Iran national football team and Hamburg SV midfielder.

zh.s: 2013年哈兹菲杯决赛是1975年以来该赛事的第26届决赛。比赛是波斯波利斯与塞帕罕之间的伊朗国家德比。两队此前曾在2006年决赛中交手，当时塞帕罕在点球大战中以4比2击败波斯波利斯。这场比赛也是波斯波利斯队长迈赫迪·马达维基亚的最后一场比赛；他曾效力伊朗国家队和汉堡队。

en.s: The Depsang standoff, also called Depsang incursion, or Daulat Beg Oldi incident, was an incursion and sit-in by a platoon-sized contingent of the Chinese PLA in the dry river bed of Raki Nala, in the Depsang Bulge area, 30 km south of Daulat Beg Oldi near the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in the disputed Aksai Chin region.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 德普桑对峙事件也称德普桑入侵或道拉特贝格奥尔迪事件，是一支排规模的中国人民解放军部队进入并驻留在拉基纳拉干涸河床的事件。地点位于有争议的阿克赛钦地区、实际控制线附近，距道拉特贝格奥尔迪以南30公里，处于德普桑突出部区域。

en.s: Festival de las Máscaras (2015) (Spanish for "Festival of the Mask") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on May 5, 2015 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. For this annual event IWRG has gotten special permission from the "Comisión de Box y Lucha Libre Mexico D.F." (Mexico City Boxing and Wrestling Commission) to allow wrestlers who had previously been unmasked after losing a Luchas de Apuestas, or bet match, to wear their masks again for this show only.

zh.s: 《面具节》（Festival de las Máscaras，西班牙语意为“面具节”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟国际摔角革命集团举办的年度大型赛事。2015年5月5日，赛事在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。国际摔角革命集团每年都会向墨西哥城拳击与摔角委员会申请特别许可，让此前在“赌注赛”中输掉面具的摔角选手仅在这场赛事中重新戴上面具。

en.s: The 2015 Denver mayoral election took place on May 5, 2015. Incumbent Michael Hancock ran for re-election and won.

zh.s: 2015年5月5日举行丹佛市长选举。时任市长迈克尔·汉考克竞选连任并获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Lincoln, Nebraska mayoral election took place on May 5, 2015. Incumbent Mayor Chris Beutler ran for re-election to a third term. He defeated Lancaster County Treasurer Andy Stebbing by a slim margin, winning 53% of the vote.

zh.t: 2015年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举
zh.s: 2015年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举于5月5日举行。时任市长Chris Beutler竞选连任，争取第三个任期。他以微弱优势击败兰开斯特县财务主管Andy Stebbing，获得53%的选票。

en.s: The 2015 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 7 and May 5, 2015, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw election of Ethan Berkowitz. Since no candidate obtained a 45% plurality in the first round, a runoff was held between the top-two finishers.

zh.s: 2015年安克雷奇市长选举于4月7日和5月5日举行，选出阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市长。伊桑·伯科维茨当选。第一轮投票中没有候选人获得所需的45%多数，因此前两名候选人进入决选。

en.t: 2015 New York's 11th congressional district special election
en.s: A special election for New York's 11th congressional district was held on May 5, 2015, to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Michael Grimm. Grimm, a member of the Republican Party, announced on December 30, 2014, that he would resign from the House effective January 5, 2015, and not take his seat for a third term following his guilty plea for tax evasion.

zh.t: 纽约州第11国会选区2015年特别选举
zh.s: 纽约州第11国会选区于2015年5月5日举行特别选举，以填补迈克尔·格林辞职后留下的空缺。共和党籍的格林于2014年12月30日宣布辞职，自2015年1月5日起离开众议院；他此前承认逃税，并决定不开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 2015 Alberta general election was held on May 5, following a request of Premier Jim Prentice to the Lieutenant Governor of Alberta Donald Ethell to dissolve the Legislative Assembly on April 7. This election elected members to the 29th Alberta Legislature.

zh.s: 2015年艾伯塔省大选于5月5日举行。4月7日，省长吉姆·普伦蒂斯请求副总督唐纳德·埃塞尔解散省议会，之后举行了此次选举，以选出艾伯塔省第29届议会成员。

en.s: The 2016 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This is on the same day as other local elections. The governing Conservative Party won 9 of the 17 seats up for election, gaining one from an Independent and losing one to the Green Party. In addition to this seat, the Greens gained another from the SDP, that of a former Green Councillor who had defected in August 2015. They also held their two existing seats to solidify their position as the Official Opposition in Solihull.

zh.t: 2016年索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年5月5日，英格兰举行索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。执政的保守党赢得17个改选席位中的9席，从一名独立议员手中赢得一席，同时又输给绿党一席。除此之外，绿党还从社会民主党手中赢得另一席，该席原由一名前绿党议员担任，此人于2015年8月退党。绿党也保住了原有的两席，巩固了其作为索利赫尔正式反对党的地位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2016 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2016 last stood for election in 2012. Each ward is represented by three councillors, the election of which is staggered, so only one third of the councillors was elected in this election. Before the election there was no overall control with a minority Labour administration.

zh.t: 2016年考尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年5月5日，英格兰举行考尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年；2016年当选的议员此前于2012年参选。每个选区由三名议员代表，分批改选，因此本次选举改选三分之一席位。选举前，议会没有任何政党取得过半席位，由工党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The National Assembly for Wales election 2016 was held on Thursday 5 May 2016, to elect members of the National Assembly for Wales (AMs). It was the fifth election for the National Assembly, the third election taken under the rules of the Government of Wales Act 2006 and the first since the Wales Act 2014. The governing Labour Party's share of the vote fell by over 7% and 29 Labour AMs were elected, one fewer than in 2011 and two short of an overall majority. Plaid Cymru became the Assembly's second largest party and the official opposition to the Welsh Government with 12 seats, one more than before.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日（星期四），威尔士举行国民议会选举，选出国民议会议员。这是国民议会的第五次选举，是《2006年威尔士政府法》实施后的第三次选举，也是《2014年威尔士法》通过后的首次选举。执政工党的得票率下降超过7个百分点，赢得29席，比2011年少1席，距离过半还差2席。威尔士党成为议会第二大党和威尔士政府的正式反对党，赢得12席，比此前增加1席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2016 Winchester City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Winchester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Every seat was contested following boundary changes which saw the number of seats reduce from 57 to 45. The count for this election was conducted on 7 May 2016. Before the election, the composition of Winchester City Council was: * Conservative 33 * Liberal Democrat 22 * Labour 2 The result of the election was: * Conservatives 25 * Liberal Democrats 20.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日，英格兰温彻斯特市议会举行选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于选区边界调整，席位从57席减至45席，全体议员参加改选。计票于5月7日进行。选举前议会席位为：保守党33席、自由民主党22席、工党2席。选举后，保守党获25席，自由民主党获20席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2016 Scottish Parliament election was held on Thursday 5 May 2016 to elect 129 members to the Scottish Parliament. It was the fifth general election since the parliament was established in 1999. It was the first parliamentary election in Scotland in which 16 and 17 year olds were able to vote, under the provisions of the Scottish Elections (Reduction of Voting Age) Act. It was also the first time the three main parties were led by women. Parliament went into dissolution on 24 March 2016, allowing the official period of campaigning to get underway.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日（星期四），苏格兰举行议会选举，选出129名议员。这是苏格兰议会自1999年成立以来的第五次大选，也是苏格兰首次允许16岁和17岁选民投票的议会选举，相关规定来自《苏格兰选举（投票年龄下调）法》。这也是三大政党首次都由女性担任领袖。议会于2016年3月24日解散，正式竞选期随后开始。

en.s: Elections to Colchester Borough Council took place on 5 May 2016. Colchester Borough Council normally elects one third of its councillors each year, however, due to boundary changes, the whole council is up for election. Prior to this election, the cabinet (8 seats) was held by a coalition including the Liberal Democrats (5 seats), the Labour Party (2 seats) and a Highwoods & Stanway Independent (1 seat). Paul Smith (Liberal Democrat), a councillor from St. John's ward, was elected Leader of the Council by 32 to 28 votes. Each voter had three available votes instead of the usual one vote.

zh.t: 2016年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举

en.s: The 2016 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Stockport Council is elected in thirds which means that in each three member local ward, one councillor is elected every year, except every four years which is classed as fallow year. The last fallow year was 2013, when no local government elections took place in the borough. Those councillors elected with serve a four-year term expiring in 2020.

en.s: The 2016 Woking Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Woking Borough Council in England. This is on the same day as other elections across the UK and the Police and Crime Commissioner election for Surrey Police. Boundary changes coincided with a shrinking of the council, so all seats were up for election. In each ward, 3 candidates were elected, with the leading candidate being elected for 4 years, the second-placed candidate being elected for 3 years and the third-placed candidate being elected for 2 years.

en.s: The 2016 Birmingham City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect one third of the members of Birmingham City Council in England. The election was held on the same day as the election of a Police and Crime Commissioner for the West Midlands as part of the 2016 Police and Crime Commissioner elections. Labour increased their hold on the City Council, winning 30 of the 40 seats up for election, gaining 1 from the Conservatives and 1 from the Liberal Democrats as well as retaining 1 previously vacant seat formerly held by a Labour Councillor.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日，英格兰举行伯明翰市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。同日还举行西米德兰兹警察与犯罪专员选举。工党进一步巩固了对市议会的控制，在40个改选席位中赢得30席，分别从保守党和自由民主党手中各赢得一席，并保住一席此前空缺的工党议员席位。

en.s: The 2016 Bristol City Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2016, alongside nationwide local elections. Following a boundary review, the number of wards in the City was reduced to 34, with each electing one, two or three Councillors. The overall number of Councillors remained 70, with all seats are up for election at the same time. Elections would then be held every 4 years. The Conservatives, Labour and the Liberal Democrats contested all 70 seats. The Green Party stood 59 candidates, TUSC 18, UKIP 10 and the Wessex Regionalists 1. There were also 8 Independent candidates.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日（星期四），布里斯托市议会选举与全国地方选举同期举行。经过选区边界审查，市内选区数量减至34个，每个选区选出1至3名议员；议员总数仍为70人，全体席位同时改选，此后每四年举行一次选举。保守党、工党和自由民主党均提名70名候选人。绿党提名59人，社会主义替代党提名18人，英国独立党提名10人，威塞克斯地区党提名1人，另有8名独立候选人。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 5 May 2016. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2020. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, managing to hold all but one seat contested and won by former Withington MP, John Leech. Leech's win signified the first gain for any party in Manchester other than Labour for the first time in six years. Councillors elected in 2012 were defending their seats this year, and vote share changes are compared on this basis.

zh.s: 2016年5月5日举行曼彻斯特市议会选举，改选议会三分之一席位。当选议员任期四年，于2020年届满。工党保住了议会控制权，除一席被威辛顿选区前国会议员约翰·利奇赢得外，其余改选席位均由工党保住。利奇当选意味着六年来曼彻斯特首次有工党以外的政党赢得席位。2012年当选的议员本次参加连任竞选，得票占比变化以他们上届的结果为比较基准。

en.s: The 2016 Thurrock Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Thurrock Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There remains no overall control of the council. The Labour administration could have continued, until removed by a special motion, but Councillor Kent chose to resign at the Annual Meeting and the leader of the Conservative group was elected to replace him.

en.s: The 2016 Exeter City Council election took place on 5 May 2016, to elect members of Exeter City Council in England. Following boundary changes, the entire council was up for election, and all 13 wards were contested, each electing three councillors. The election was held concurrently with other local elections held in England on the 5 May. The council had been controlled by the Labour Party since 1990, which had held an outright majority since 2012. Labour won the Exeter election, extending their control to 30 seats, their highest ever share of the vote.

en.t: England and Wales police and crime commissioner elections, 2016
en.s: Elections of police and crime commissioners in England and Wales were held on 5 May 2016. The elections were for 40 of the 43 territorial police forces in England and Wales using the supplementary vote system; the two police forces of Greater London are not involved (the elected Mayor of London is classed as the police and crime commissioner for the Metropolitan Police District, while the Court of Common Council fulfils the role for the City of London Police). There was no election for the Greater Manchester Police as the role of police and crime commissioner is due to be abolished in 2017 and replaced with the directly elected Mayor of Greater Manchester.

en.s: The 2016 Sunderland City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect one-third of the members of Sunderland City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections held across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2016年桑德兰市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰桑德兰市议会三分之一的席位。选举与英国各地的其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect a third of the members of Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年达德利都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年达德利都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰达德利都会自治市议会三分之一的席位。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. All 33 seats were up for election, with 3 councillors in each of the 11 wards being elected following a boundary review.

zh.s: 2016年林肯市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰林肯市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。边界审查后，11个选区各选出3名议员，全部33个席位都要改选。

en.s: The 2016 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2016年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰沃辛自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This election saw the most seats won by the Loughton Residents Association winning 13 out of 14 Loughton seats, barring one seat in Loughton Roding where long-term incumbent Stephen Murray sits.

zh.s: 2016年埃平森林区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。劳顿居民协会在劳顿的14个席位中赢得13席，是此次选举中赢得席位最多的团体；唯一例外是劳顿罗丁选区，该席位由长期担任议员的Stephen Murray赢得。

en.s: The 2016 Gosport Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Gosport Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Liberal Democrats gained two seats from the Conservatives and one from Labour, but the Conservatives remained in an overall majority.

zh.t: 2016年戈斯波特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年戈斯波特自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰戈斯波特自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。自由民主党从保守党手中赢得两席、从工党手中赢得一席，但保守党仍保持多数。

en.s: The 2016 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Rushmoor Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Note the election for Aldershot Park was postponed to 2 June due to the death of a candidate.

zh.t: 2016年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰拉什穆尔自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。由于一名候选人去世，奥尔德肖特公园选区的选举推迟至6月2日。

en.s: The 2016 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出滨海绍森德自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Daventry District Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Daventry District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Only one seat changed hands with Labour taking one seat from the Conservatives leading to the council being made up as follows; 30 Conservative councillors, 3 Labour councillors, 2 UKIP councillors and 1 Liberal Democrat councillor.

zh.s: 2016年达文特里区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰达文特里区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。只有一个席位易手：工党从保守党手中赢得一席。选举后议会由30名保守党议员、3名工党议员、2名英国独立党议员和1名自由民主党议员组成。

en.s: The 2016 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Brentwood Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伍德自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Derby City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, albeit with their majority reduced to just one seat.

zh.s: 2016年德比市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。工党继续控制议会，但多数优势缩小到仅一席。

en.s: The 2016 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Hart District Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Hart District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2016年哈特区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰哈特区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2016 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: The 2016 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Gloucester City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Gloucester City Council in England. All seats are up for election at the same time due to boundary changes. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council also changed from electing a third of the council to electing the entire council.

zh.s: 2016年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会成员。由于选区边界调整，全体席位都要改选。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。议会也从每年改选三分之一席位改为一次改选全部席位。

en.s: The 2016 Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. All seats were up for election following boundary changes that came into effect that year. Despite a relatively minor drop in their share of the popular vote, the boundary changes resulted in the Conservatives losing several seats on the council, although they still maintained majority control.

zh.t: 2016年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。由于当年实施了新的选区边界，全体席位都要改选。保守党的得票率略有下降，边界调整也使该党失去若干席位，但仍保持议会多数。

en.s: The 2016 Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Sefton is divided into 22 wards, each electing 3 councillors, totalling up to 66 seats. Note, only 22 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2016年塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰塞夫顿都会自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。塞夫顿分为22个选区，每区选出3名议员，合计最多66席。本次只有22席改选。

en.s: The 2016 Havant Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Havant Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2016年哈文特自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰哈文特自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Sheffield Brightside and Hillsborough was held on 5 May 2016, following the death of incumbent Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) Harry Harpham. It was won by Gill Furniss—Harpham's widow—also of Labour. It took place on the same day as the 2016 Ogmore by-election and local elections across the UK.

zh.t: 2016年谢菲尔德布赖特赛德和希尔斯伯勒选区补选
zh.s: 英国议会谢菲尔德布赖特赛德和希尔斯伯勒选区于2016年5月5日举行补选，原因是该选区工党议员Harry Harpham去世。工党候选人Gill Furniss（Harpham的遗孀）赢得选举。补选与2016年奥格莫尔选区补选及英国各地的地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年桑德韦尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年桑德韦尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰桑德韦尔都会自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Rochford District Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Rochford District Council in England. Due to boundary changes, all seats on the council were up for election at the same time, with each ward electing three Councillors. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2016年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰罗奇福德区议会成员。由于选区边界调整，议会全体席位都要改选，每个选区选出三名议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Runnymede Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect 15 members of Runnymede Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2016年伦尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2016年伦尼米德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰萨里郡伦尼米德自治市议会的15名成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The elections for Oxford City Council took place on 5 May 2016. This was on the same day as other local elections. As Oxford City Council is elected by halves, one seat in each of the 24 wards is up for election. Overall turnout was 39.2%. The highest turnout was 53.9% for Iffley Fields, and the lowest 18.6% for Northfield Brook.

zh.s: 牛津市议会选举于2016年5月5日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。牛津市议会每次改选一半席位，因此24个选区各有一个席位改选。整体投票率为39.2%；艾夫利菲尔兹选区最高，为53.9%，诺斯菲尔德布鲁克选区最低，为18.6%。

en.s: The 2016 Portsmouth City Council election took place on 5 May 2016 to elect members of Portsmouth City Council. This took place on the same day as other local elections taking place around the UK, including the London Mayoral election, Scottish Parliament and Welsh Assembly elections. 14 of 42 seats were contested during these elections within this unitary authority.

zh.s: 2016年朴茨茅斯市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出朴茨茅斯市议会成员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行，包括伦敦市长选举、苏格兰议会选举和威尔士议会选举。这个单一层级地方政府有42个席位，其中14席在此次选举中改选。

en.s: The 2016 Svenska Cupen final was played on 5 May 2016. The match was played at Swedbank Stadion, Malmö, the home ground of Malmö FF, determined in a draw on 21 March 2016 after the semi-finals. The final was the culmination of the 2015–16 Svenska Cupen. Allsvenskan clubs Malmö FF and BK Häcken contested the 2016 final, with the winner earning a place in the second qualifying round of the 2016–17 UEFA Europa League.

zh.s: 2016年瑞典杯决赛于2016年5月5日举行。比赛在马尔默FF主场马尔默新球场进行，比赛场地于半决赛后、2016年3月21日抽签决定。这是2015—16赛季瑞典杯的决赛。瑞典超级联赛球队马尔默FF和赫根BK争夺冠军；获胜球队将获得2016—17赛季欧洲联赛第二轮资格赛的参赛席位。

en.s: The 2016 North Hertfordshire Council election was held on 5 May 2016, at the same time as other local elections across England. Of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council, 15 were up for election. The Conservatives lost two seats, one to Labour and one to the Liberal Democrats, but retained their overall majority on the council.

zh.t: 2016年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2016年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月5日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会49个席位中有15席改选。保守党失去两席，分别由工党和自由民主党赢得，但仍保持议会多数。

en.s: The 2016 London mayoral election was held on 5 May 2016 to elect the Mayor of London, on the same day as the London Assembly election. It was the fifth election to the position of mayor, which was created in 2000 following a referendum in Greater London. The election used a supplementary vote system.

zh.s: 2016年伦敦市长选举于5月5日举行，选出伦敦市长，与伦敦议会选举同日进行。这是自2000年大伦敦公投后设立市长职位以来的第五次选举。此次采用补充投票制。

en.s: The 2016 London Assembly election was held on 5 May 2016 to elect the members of the London Assembly. It took place on the same day as the London mayoral election and the United Kingdom local elections. Four parties had AMs in the previous Assembly: London Labour, led by Len Duvall, London Conservatives led by Gareth Bacon, London Greens led by Siân Berry, and the London Liberal Democrats led by Caroline Pidgeon.

zh.s: 2016年伦敦议会选举于5月5日举行，选出伦敦议会成员，与伦敦市长选举及英国地方选举同日进行。上届议会中有四个政党拥有议员：由Len Duvall领导的伦敦工党、由Gareth Bacon领导的伦敦保守党、由Siân Berry领导的伦敦绿党，以及由Caroline Pidgeon领导的伦敦自由民主党。

en.s: The 2016 Northern Ireland Assembly election was held on Thursday, 5 May 2016. It was the fifth election to take place since the devolved assembly was established in 1998. 1,281,595 individuals were registered to vote in the election (representing an increase of 5.9% compared to the previous Assembly election).

zh.s: 北爱尔兰议会选举于2016年5月5日星期四举行。这是1998年设立权力下放议会以来的第五次选举。共有1,281,595人登记投票，比上届议会选举增加5.9%。

en.s: The UAAP Season 78 Men's Football Final took place on 5 May 2016 at the Rizal Memorial Stadium, featuring a matchup between UP Fighting Maroons and Ateneo Blue Eagles. UP won 4–1, with one goal from Daniel Gadia and a hat-trick from Kintaro Miyagi, to claim their sixth UAAP Football Championship final victory; Ateneo's goal was scored by Mikko Mabanag.

zh.s: UAAP第78赛季男子足球决赛于2016年5月5日在黎刹纪念体育场举行，由菲律宾大学斗士队对阵雅典耀蓝鹰队。菲律宾大学以4比1获胜，Daniel Gadia打入一球，Kintaro Miyagi上演帽子戏法，帮助球队第六次赢得UAAP足球冠军决赛。雅典耀的进球由Mikko Mabanag打入。

en.s: Sheffield City Council elections took place on Thursday 5 May 2016, alongside nationwide local elections. All 84 seats were up for election, 3 per ward, after several electoral boundaries were changed. Labour, the Liberal Democrats and the Green Party contested all 84 seats. The Conservatives fielded 55 candidates, UKIP 43, TUSC 23 and Yorkshire First 1. There was also 1 independent candidate.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2016年5月5日星期四举行，与全国各地的地方选举同时进行。选区边界调整后，全体84个席位都要改选，每个选区选出3名议员。工党、自由民主党和绿党均派候选人竞选全部84席。保守党提名55人，英国独立党提名43人，社会主义联盟（TUSC）提名23人，约克郡第一党提名1人，另有1名独立候选人。

en.s: A by-thirds Hyndburn Borough Council local election took place on 5 May 2016. Approximately one third of the local council's 35 seats fell up for election on that day. The following year (one year out of four, next due in 2017) sees Lancashire County Council elections for all residents of this borough.

zh.s: 海德本自治市议会地方选举于2016年5月5日举行，采用每年改选三分之一席位的方式。该地方议会35个席位中约三分之一在当天改选。次年（四年周期中的一年，下一次预定于2017年）将举行兰开夏郡议会选举，该自治市所有居民均可参加。

en.s: On 5 May 2017, an armed skirmish occurred after Afghan forces attacked a Pakistani census team in Chaman, in Pakistan near the border with Afghanistan. At least 15 people died on both sides in the immediate border clash. It is one of a series of similar border-related incidents between the two countries.

zh.t: 2017年阿富汗—巴基斯坦边境冲突
zh.s: 2017年5月5日，阿富汗部队袭击了巴基斯坦一支人口普查队，随后双方在巴基斯坦查曼、靠近阿富汗边境处发生武装冲突。边境交火中双方至少有15人死亡。这是两国之间一系列类似边境事件之一。

en.s: The 2017 raid on Barii was a military operation conducted by SEAL Team Six (DEVGRU) Silver squadron with Danab commandos from the Federal Government of Somalia. The raid resulted in the death of DEVGRU Senior Chief Petty Officer Kyle Milliken, marking the first US serviceman combat death in Somalia since the First Battle of Mogadishu in 1993, also known as "Black Hawk Down".

zh.s: 2017年巴里突袭行动由海豹突击队第六分队（DEVGRU）银队与索马里联邦政府的达纳布突击队共同执行。这次行动导致DEVGRU高级首席军士官Kyle Milliken死亡，这是自1993年摩加迪沙第一次战役（又称「黑鹰坠落」）以来，首位在索马里战斗中阵亡的美国军人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2018 Women's FA Cup final was the 48th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 25th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA) and was named the SSE Women's FA Cup Final due to sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Arsenal and Chelsea on 5 May 2018 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2018年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该赛事第48届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛决赛。此次决赛是英格兰足球总会（FA）直接主办的第25届，因赞助原因称为SSE英格兰足总女子杯决赛。阿森纳与切尔西于2018年5月5日在伦敦温布利球场争夺冠军。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 5 May 2018. The two seats up for elections were Hobart and Prosser. Hobart was previously contested in 2012. Prosser was a new division created in the 2017 redistribution, and was vacant pending this election.

zh.t: 2018年塔斯马尼亚立法会周期性选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会周期性选举于2018年5月5日举行。此次改选霍巴特和普罗瑟两个席位。霍巴特席位上次于2012年改选；普罗瑟是2017年选区重新划分后设立的新选区，在本次选举前一直空缺。

en.s: The 2018 A-League Grand Final was the thirteenth A-League Grand Final, played on 5 May 2018. The match took place at McDonald Jones Stadium, with Newcastle Jets hosting Melbourne Victory, the first A-League grand final held outside a capital city. Kosta Barbarouses scored the only goal of the game, in the 9th minute.

zh.t: 2018年澳大利亚甲级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 第13届澳大利亚甲级联赛总决赛于2018年5月5日举行，在麦克唐纳·琼斯体育场进行，由纽卡斯尔喷气机队主场迎战墨尔本胜利队。这是澳大利亚甲级联赛总决赛首次在非首府城市举行。科斯塔·巴巴鲁塞斯在第9分钟打入全场唯一进球。

en.s: General elections were held in Panama on 5 May 2019. Due to constitutional term limits, incumbent President Juan Carlos Varela was ineligible for a second consecutive term. Businessman and politician Laurentino Cortizo of the centre-left Democratic Revolutionary Party won the election with around 33% of the vote, narrowly defeating Rómulo Roux of the centre-right Democratic Change, who won 31% of the vote.

zh.s: 巴拿马于2019年5月5日举行大选。根据宪法任期限制，时任总统胡安·卡洛斯·巴雷拉不能连续竞选第二个任期。中左翼民主革命党商人兼政治人物劳伦蒂诺·科尔蒂索以约33%的得票率胜选，险胜中右翼民主变革党的罗慕洛·鲁克斯；后者得票率为31%。

en.s: Code Red was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling, in conjunction with House of Glory, which aired exclusively on Impact Plus. It was the first special for Impact Plus, a streaming service launched as a successor to the Global Wrestling Network. The event took place on May 5, 2019 at the NYC Arena in New York City, New York.

zh.s: 《Code Red》是由Impact Wrestling与House of Glory联合举办的职业摔角赛事，仅在Impact Plus平台播出。这是Impact Plus的首场特别赛事。Impact Plus是一项流媒体服务，取代了Global Wrestling Network。赛事于2019年5月5日在美国纽约州纽约市的NYC Arena举行。

en.s: The 2019 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Eredivisie clubs Willem II and Ajax that took place on 5 May 2019 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2018–19 KNVB Cup, the 101st season of the annual Dutch national football cup competition. The winners of this match would compete in the 2019 Johan Cruyff Shield and play in the 2019–20 UEFA Europa League, assuming they have not qualified for the 2019–20 UEFA Champions League.

zh.s: 2019年荷兰杯决赛于2019年5月5日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由荷甲球队威廉二世对阵阿贾克斯。这是2018—19赛季荷兰杯的决赛，也是这项年度荷兰足球杯赛的第101个赛季决赛。获胜球队将参加2019年约翰·克鲁伊夫盾杯，并获得2019—20赛季欧联杯资格；前提是该队没有取得2019—20赛季欧冠参赛资格。

en.s: The 2019 Tell Rifaat Clashes were a military confrontation between Turkey and allied Free Syrian Army groups against the Kurdish People's Protection Units (YPG) in early May 2019.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2019年泰勒里法特冲突是土耳其及其盟友自由叙利亚军团与库尔德人民保卫军（YPG）之间的军事对抗，发生于2019年5月初。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in North Macedonia in 2019. Three candidates were on the ballot in the first round, held on 21 April: Stevo Pendarovski, supported by the ruling coalition led by the Social Democratic Union of Macedonia, including the Democratic Union for Integration; Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova of the leading opposition party VMRO-DPMNE, and Blerim Reka, an independent supported by Albanian opposition parties Alliance for Albanians and Besa Movement.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 北马其顿于2019年举行总统选举。首轮投票于4月21日进行，共有三名候选人参选：由执政联盟（包括融合民主联盟）支持的社会民主联盟候选人斯特沃·彭达罗夫斯基；主要反对党VMRO-DPMNE候选人格尔达娜·西利亚诺夫斯卡-达夫科娃；以及由阿尔巴尼亚族反对党联盟“阿尔巴尼亚人联盟”和“贝萨运动”支持的独立候选人布莱里姆·雷卡。
zh.n: 此条记录的是第二轮投票；日期按原文信息框记载。
