en.t: 2019 Croatian national minorities councils and representatives elections
en.s: The 2019 Croatian national minorities' councils and representatives elections took place on 5 May. The elections were the fifth minority elections since 2003 and near 254,000 citizens of Croatia were entitled to vote on them. In total, 352 councils and 109 representatives were up for election. 14 minority groups were electing their councils while 20 minority groups were electing representatives. 6,686 candidates in total participated in elections which were conducted at 846 polling places.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2019年克罗地亚少数民族委员会及代表选举
zh.s: 2019年克罗地亚少数民族委员会及代表选举于5月5日举行。这是自2003年以来第五次少数民族选举，约有254,000名克罗地亚公民具备投票资格。此次共改选352个委员会和109名代表；14个少数民族群体选举委员会，20个群体选举代表。共有6,686名候选人参选，投票在846个投票站进行。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源信息框所列的首轮投票日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 1492 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by Aeroflot from Moscow–Sheremetyevo to Murmansk, Russia. On 5 May 2019, the Sukhoi Superjet 100 aircraft operating the flight was climbing out when it was struck by lightning. The aircraft suffered an electrical failure and returned to Sheremetyevo for an emergency landing.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空1492号班机事故
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空1492号班机是一班由莫斯科谢列梅捷沃飞往俄罗斯摩尔曼斯克的定期国内客运航班。2019年5月5日，执飞该航班的苏霍伊超级喷气机100型客机爬升时遭雷击，发生电气故障，随后返回谢列梅捷沃机场紧急降落。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; linked English introduction and Chinese occurrence-date infobox

en.s: Beginning on 5 May 2020, Chinese and Indian troops engaged in aggressive melee, face-offs, and skirmishes at locations along the Sino-Indian border, including near the disputed Pangong Lake in Ladakh and the Tibet Autonomous Region, and near the border between Sikkim and the Tibet Autonomous Region. Additional clashes also took place at locations in eastern Ladakh along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

zh.s: 自2020年5月5日起，中国和印度军队在中印边境多处发生激烈肢体冲突、对峙和小规模交火，包括拉达克有争议的班公湖附近、藏族自治区域，以及锡金与藏族自治区域交界处。拉达克东部实际控制线沿线也发生了其他冲突。

en.s: The 2022 Perth and Kinross Council election was held on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the 12 wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 40 councillors elected. Each ward elects either 3 or 4 members - using the STV electoral system - a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2022年珀斯和金罗斯议会选举于5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府的选举同日进行。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个选区，共选出40名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制，这是一种比例代表制。

en.s: The 2022 Caerphilly County Borough Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect 69 members to the Caerphilly County Borough Council in Wales, as a part of both the 2022 Welsh local elections, and the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. The electoral ward divisions had been altered, and the number of councillors elected had dropped from 73 to 69. Labour held their majority of the council.

zh.t: 2022年卡菲利郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年卡菲利郡自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出威尔士卡菲利郡自治市议会的69名成员，是2022年威尔士地方选举和英国地方选举的一部分。选区划分经过调整，议员人数从73人减至69人。工党保住了议会多数。

en.s: Elections to Cannock Chase District Council took place on 5 May 2022 on the same day as other local elections in England, Scotland and Wales. All but two of the council's wards were up for election, meaning a total of 13 councillors were elected. At the previous local election in Cannock Chase, the Conservatives won their first overall majority in the history of the council.

zh.s: 坎诺克蔡斯区议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士的其他地方选举同日进行。除两个选区外，其余选区都进行改选，共选出13名议员。上一次坎诺克蔡斯地方选举中，保守党首次在该议会赢得多数。

en.s: The 2022 West Lancashire Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of West Lancashire Borough Council in Lancashire, England.

zh.t: 2022年西兰开夏自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年西兰开夏自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡西兰开夏自治市议会成员。

en.s: The 2022 Westmorland and Furness Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Westmorland and Furness Council in England. The council area consists of the area covered by the districts of Barrow-in-Furness, Eden and South Lakeland. These were the first elections to the new authority, with the council acting as a 'shadow authority' until the abolition of the three former districts and Cumbria County Council on 1 April 2023.

zh.t: 2022年威斯特摩兰和弗内斯议会选举
zh.s: 2022年威斯特摩兰和弗内斯议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰威斯特摩兰和弗内斯议会成员。该议会辖区由原巴罗因弗内斯、伊甸和南湖区组成。这是新议会首次选举；在原有三个区和坎布里亚郡议会于2023年4月1日撤销前，新议会先以「影子议会」形式运作。

en.s: The 2022 United Kingdom local elections took place on Thursday 5 May 2022. These included elections for all London borough councils, and for all local authorities in Wales and Scotland. Most seats in England were last up for election in 2018 and in Scotland and Wales in 2017. The elections coincided with the 2022 Northern Ireland Assembly election.

zh.s: 2022年英国地方选举于5月5日星期四举行。选举包括伦敦所有自治市议会，以及威尔士和苏格兰所有地方政府。英格兰大部分席位上次于2018年改选，苏格兰和威尔士的多数席位上次于2017年改选。此次地方选举与2022年北爱尔兰议会选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Cardiff Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect 79 members to Cardiff Council. On the same day, elections were held to the other 21 local authorities and to community councils in Wales as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections. The 2022 election had been postponed from 2021, and was contested under new ward boundaries, which also increased the number of seats from 75 to 79.

zh.s: 2022年卡迪夫议会选举于5月5日举行，选出卡迪夫议会的79名成员。同日，威尔士另外21个地方政府及各社区议会也举行选举，属于2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。此次选举原定于2021年举行，后延期；选举按新的选区边界进行，席位也从75个增至79个。

en.s: The 2022 Maidstone Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022, in order to elect 18 out of 55 members to the Maidstone Borough Council. These seats were last up for election in 2018. Members elected in this election would have their seats next up for election in 2024, due to the council opting for a four-year cycle of elections instead of the current format from 2024 onwards.

zh.t: 2022年梅德斯通自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年梅德斯通自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选55个席位中的18席。这些席位上次于2018年改选。由于议会选择每四年举行一次选举，而非自2024年起实施的现行安排，本次当选议员的席位将在2024年再次改选。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 5 May 2022 to elect members to the twenty-two local authorities. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections were held in 2017. The Welsh Conservatives lost over a third of their seats and their majority on Monmouthshire County Council.

zh.s: 威尔士地方选举于2022年5月5日举行，选出22个地方政府的议员。选举与英国其他地方选举同时举行。上一次选举于2017年举行。威尔士保守党失去了超过三分之一的席位，也失去了在蒙茅斯郡议会的多数。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Borough Council took place on 5 May 2022. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 2018. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it has held continuously since its creation in 1973.

zh.t: 2022年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选，这些席位上次于2018年改选。工党继续控制议会；自议会1973年成立以来，一直由工党执政。

en.s: The 2022 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council, on the same day as other UK local elections. The Labour Party won control of the council for the first time, ending 18 years of Conservative administration.

zh.s: 2022年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出沃辛自治市议会成员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。工党首次取得议会控制权，结束了保守党长达18年的执政。

en.t: 2022 Blaenau Gwent County Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Blaenau Gwent County Borough Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2022 to elect the 33 members to the Blaenau Gwent County Borough Council in Wales, as a part of both the 2022 Welsh local elections, and the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. The electoral ward divisions had been altered, and the number of councillors elected had dropped from 33 to 30.

zh.t: 2022年布莱瑙格温郡级自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布莱瑙格温郡级自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日（星期四）举行，选出威尔士布莱瑙格温郡级自治市议会的33名成员。该选举属于2022年威尔士地方选举和2022年英国地方选举的一部分。选区划分经过调整，议员人数从33人减少到30人。

en.s: The 2022 Cambridge City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Cambridge City Council. This was on the same day as other local elections were held across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2022年剑桥市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出剑桥市议会成员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Slough Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Slough Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2022年斯劳自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰斯劳自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Hastings Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Hastings Borough Council in the county of East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 16 of the 32 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年黑斯廷斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年黑斯廷斯自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡黑斯廷斯自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。32个席位中有16席改选。

en.t: 2022 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2022 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 5 May 2022, to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in England. It was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries. At the election, the Liberal Democrats retained control of the council with a greatly increased majority, while Labour were eliminated from the council entirely.

zh.t: 2022年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举
zh.s: 2022年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰圣奥尔本斯市和区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。全体议席按新的选区边界改选。自由民主党大幅扩大多数优势，继续控制议会；工党则失去了全部席位。

en.s: The 2022 Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council election to elect members of Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council in England took place on 5 May 2022. One third of the 63 seats were contested, with one additional seat also contested in Gorse Hill as a by-election owing to a councillor retiring mid-term. Each successful candidate will serve a one-year term of office rather than the normal four-year term due to a boundary review to be implemented in 2023.

zh.t: 2022年特拉福德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年特拉福德都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰特拉福德都会自治市议会成员。63个席位中通常应改选的三分之一参与选举，戈斯山选区另有一个空缺席位补选，原因是一名议员在任期中退休。由于2023年将实施选区边界审查，所有当选议员的任期为一年，而非通常的四年。

en.s: The 2022 Sheffield City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Sheffield City Council in England, as part of the nationwide local elections. One seat from each ward was up for election. This was the first election held since the formation of a Labour-Green coalition in 2021, following the loss of Labour's overall majority on the council.

zh.s: 2022年谢菲尔德市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰谢菲尔德市议会成员，是全国地方选举的一部分。每个选区有一个席位改选。这是2021年工党与绿党组建联合政府后首次举行的选举；此前工党失去了议会多数。

en.s: The 2022 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This is expected to be the last election to the council where a third of councillors are elected, following recommendations from a government report into the Council's finances.

zh.t: 2022年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都会自治市议会成员。根据一份关于该议会财政状况的政府报告所提建议，这可能是最后一次按每年改选三分之一议员的方式举行选举。

en.s: The 2022 Leeds City Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2022 to elect members of Leeds City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. As per the election cycle, one third of the council's 99 seats were contested alongside two casual vacancies in the Horsforth and Roundhay wards.

zh.s: 2022年利兹市议会选举于5月5日星期四举行，选出英格兰利兹市议会成员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。按照选举周期，99个席位中的三分之一改选，霍斯福斯和朗德黑两个选区另有两个空缺席位补选。

en.t: 2022 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。三分之一的席位改选。

en.s: The first election to Cumberland Council was held on 5 May 2022, with all 46 seats contested. The election created a shadow authority for the new unitary authority, which operated alongside Allerdale Borough Council, Carlisle City Council, Copeland Borough Council and Cumbria County Council for eleven months. On 1 April 2023, Cumberland Council assumed the functions of those councils within its area.

zh.s: 坎伯兰议会首次选举于2022年5月5日举行，全部46个席位都要改选。选举产生了新单一层级地方政府的影子议会；在此后的11个月里，它与阿勒代尔区议会、卡莱尔市议会、科普兰区议会及坎布里亚郡议会并行运作。2023年4月1日，坎伯兰议会接管了这些议会在其辖区内的职能。

en.s: The 2022 Redditch Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Redditch Borough Council, a district-level local authority in Worcestershire, England.

zh.s: 2022年雷迪奇自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰伍斯特郡雷迪奇自治市议会成员。

en.s: Elections to Dundee City Council took place on 5 May 2022, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 邓迪市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，此次采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Plymouth City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. It coincided with local elections across the United Kingdom. The Conservative Party made gains in the previous election in 2021, resulting in the council entering no overall control with no party holding a majority of seats. Immediately following the results of the 2022 election, the council remained in no overall control.

zh.s: 2022年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会成员，与英国各地地方选举同时举行。保守党在2021年上次选举中增加席位，之后议会变为无人占多数，没有政党拥有多数席位。2022年选举结果公布后，议会仍无人占多数。

en.s: The 2022 Tunbridge Wells Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect one third of Tunbridge Wells Borough Council in England.

zh.t: 2022年滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰滕布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会三分之一的席位。

en.t: 2022 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2022 to elect the 30 members to the Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council in Wales, as a part of both the 2022 Welsh local elections, and the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. The electoral ward divisions had been altered, and the number of councillors elected had dropped from 33 to 30.

zh.t: 2022年梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举于5月5日星期四举行，选出威尔士梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会的30名成员，是2022年威尔士地方选举和英国地方选举的一部分。选区划分经过调整，议员人数从33人减至30人。

en.s: The 2022 Harlow District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2022年哈洛区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 North Hertfordshire District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect 18 of the 49 members of North Hertfordshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections around the country. The council remained under no overall control, with a Labour and Liberal Democrat coalition continuing to run the council.

zh.t: 2022年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2022年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰北赫特福德郡区议会49个席位中的18席。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。议会仍无人占多数，由工党和自由民主党组建的联合政府继续执政。

en.s: The 2022 Norwich City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Norwich City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 13 of 39 seats (one-third) were up for election.

zh.s: 2022年诺里奇市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰诺里奇市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。39个席位中的13席（三分之一）改选。

en.s: The 2022 Wokingham Borough Council election took place as of Thursday 5 May 2022. That was the same day as other United Kingdom local elections in order to elect members of Wokingham Unitary Council in Berkshire, England. One third of the council, 18 seats, was up for election and the Conservative Party lost control of the council, but was the largest group.

zh.t: 2022年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举于5月5日星期四举行，选出英格兰伯克郡沃金厄姆单一层级议会成员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一、共18个席位改选。保守党失去议会控制权，但仍是最大党团。

en.s: The 2022 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2022年林肯市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡林肯市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Adur District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Adur District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 14 of the 29 seats were up for election.

zh.s: 2022年阿杜尔区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出阿杜尔区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。29个席位中有14席改选。

en.s: Elections to Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council took place on 5 May 2022. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 2022年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Brentwood Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2022年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伍德自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place 5 May 2022 to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 21 of the 63 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出斯托克波特都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，63个席位中有21席改选。

en.s: The 2022 Runnymede Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect one-third of members of the Runnymede Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in the U.K. Since its first election in 1973, the council has been under Conservative control, apart from a short period between 1996 and 1998 when it was under no overall control.

zh.t: 2022年伦尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年伦尼米德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰伦尼米德自治市议会三分之一的席位，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。自1973年首次选举以来，除1996年至1998年短暂无人占多数外，议会一直由保守党控制。

en.s: The 2022 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. Eighteen members of the council (one-third of the whole) were elected: one from 16 of the 17 wards, and two councillors from New Town & Christ Church ward, following the death of incumbent councillor Nick Cope (Liberal Democrats), elected in 2019 and due to serve until 2023.

zh.t: 2022年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。议会三分之一、共18名成员当选：17个选区中的16个各选出一人；由于自由民主党议员Nick Cope去世，新镇与基督教堂选区选出两名议员。Cope于2019年当选，原定任职至2023年。

en.s: The 2022 Exeter City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members to Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom. 17 of the 39 seats were up for election, one councillor in each of the 13 wards, and 4 by-elections. These wards were last contested in 2018.

zh.s: 2022年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会成员，与英国其他地方选举同日举行。39个席位中有17席改选：13个选区各改选一席，另有4场补选。这些席位上次于2018年改选。

en.s: The 2022 Worcester City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect councillors to Worcester City Council in England.

zh.s: 2022年伍斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰伍斯特市议会成员。

en.s: The elections to Amber Valley Borough Council in Derbyshire, England took place on Thursday 5 May 2022. One third of the council were up for election. The Conservatives increased their majority on the council whilst the Green Party also gained seats. This election was the last by thirds election and the last before boundary changes proposed by the Local Government Boundary Commission came into effect at the 2023 election.

zh.s: 英格兰德比郡安伯谷自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日星期四举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。保守党扩大了多数优势，绿党也赢得若干席位。这是最后一次按每年改选三分之一议员的方式举行选举，也是地方政府边界委员会提出的选区调整在2023年选举中生效前的最后一次选举。

en.s: The 2022 Cherwell District Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Cherwell District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2022年切尔韦尔区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰切尔韦尔区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Wakefield Metropolitan District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Wakefield Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 21 of the 63 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年韦克菲尔德都会区议会选举
zh.s: 2022年韦克菲尔德都会区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出韦克菲尔德议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。63个席位中有21席改选。

en.s: Elections for the London Borough of Merton were held on 5 May 2022 to elect all 57 members of Merton London Borough Council in England. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. The 2022 election took place under new election boundaries, which reduced the number of councillors from 60 to 57.

zh.t: 2022年默顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 默顿伦敦自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，选出英格兰默顿伦敦自治市议会全部57名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。此次选举采用新的选区边界，议员人数从60人减至57人。

en.s: Elections to Swindon Borough Council took place on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 local elections in the United Kingdom. The Conservatives lost 3 seats but maintained their majority control of the council.

zh.s: 斯温顿自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党失去3席，但继续控制议会。

en.s: An election to Reading Borough Council took place as of 5 May 2022. Following boundary changes all the seats on the council were up for election.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部席位都要改选。

en.s: The 2022 Newcastle City Council election took place on 5 May 2022. Twenty-seven of the 78 seats on Newcastle City Council were contested: the usual third of the council, plus a casual vacancy in Benwell and Scotswood. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, holding 52 seats after the election.

zh.s: 2022年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月5日举行。纽卡斯尔市议会78个席位中有27席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及本韦尔和斯科茨伍德选区的一个空缺席位补选。选举与英国其他地方选举同时举行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，选后拥有52席。

en.s: The 2022 Huntingdonshire District Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Huntingdonshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The elections saw two councillors elected unopposed, the first uncontested elections in the district since 1988.

zh.s: 2022年亨廷登郡区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰亨廷登郡区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。两名议员未经竞争当选，这是该区自1988年以来首次出现无人竞争的选举。

en.s: Elections to the City of Edinburgh Council took place on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，此次采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections. A by-election was held on the same day in Leigh East ward to fill the seat left vacant by the death of Labour councillor Anita Thorpe.

zh.t: 2022年威根都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年威根都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰威根都会自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。当天，利东选区还举行补选，以填补工党议员Anita Thorpe去世后留下的空缺。

en.s: Elections to Glasgow City Council took place on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 格拉斯哥市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，此次采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Milton Keynes Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Milton Keynes Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 2022年米尔顿凯恩斯议会选举于5月5日举行，选出米尔顿凯恩斯议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。

en.t: 2022 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council. Seventeen seats of the thirty-four seats on the council were elected, as part of the wider 2022 local elections. The Conservative Party won twelve of the contested seats. As a result, they retained overall control of the council for the first time in the history of the borough.

zh.t: 2022年纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会成员，是当年地方选举的一部分。议会34个席位中有17席改选。保守党赢得其中12席，因此首次在该自治市历史上继续保持议会控制权。

en.s: The 2022 North East Lincolnshire Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of North East Lincolnshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2022年东北林肯郡议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰东北林肯郡议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Cheltenham Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Cheltenham Borough Council in Gloucestershire, England. Half of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 2022年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特郡切尔滕纳姆自治市议会成员。议会一半席位改选。

en.s: The 2022 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. One third of councillors — 17 out of 51, plus one vacancy in Ovenden ward were up for election. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, Labour maintained its control of the council, holding 28 seats after the election.

zh.t: 2022年卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会成员。51个席位中有17席（三分之一）改选，奥文登选区另有一个空缺席位补选。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同时举行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，选后拥有28席。

en.s: The 2022 Wrexham County Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect 56 members to Wrexham County Borough Council, the principal council of Wrexham County Borough, Wales. On the same day, elections were held to the other 21 local authorities, and community councils in Wales as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections.

zh.t: 2022年雷克瑟姆郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年雷克瑟姆郡自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出威尔士雷克瑟姆郡自治市议会的56名成员。当天，威尔士另外21个地方政府及各社区议会也举行了选举，属于2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2022 Derby City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.s: 2022年德比市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。议会三分之一的席位改选。

en.s: Council elections for the Borough of Chorley were held on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. A third of the council was up for election. The result was a hold for the ruling Labour group.

zh.s: 乔利自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。执政的工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2022 Castle Point Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Castle Point Borough Council in England.

zh.t: 2022年卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰卡斯尔波因特自治市议会成员。

en.s: Elections to Ipswich Borough Council (IBC) took place on 5 May 2022. 17 seats were contested – one in each of the 16 wards, plus an additional bye election in St John's Ward. The Conservatives failed to capitalise on any of the gains they had made in the previous year, and lost two seats to Labour.

zh.t: 2022年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，共有17席改选：16个选区各改选一席，圣约翰选区另举行一场补选。保守党未能巩固上一年的胜利，反而失去两席给工党。

en.s: Elections to Gosport Borough Council took place on the 5th May 2022 as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. The Liberal Democrats gained control of the council from the Conservative Party.

zh.t: 2022年戈斯波特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 戈斯波特自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。自由民主党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2022 Scottish local elections were held on 5 May 2022, as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. All 1,226 seats across all 32 Scottish local authorities were up for election and voter turnout was 44.8%. Compared to the previous elections of 2017, the Scottish National Party (SNP) gained seats and maintained its position as largest party in local government, winning 36.9% of the seats available.

zh.s: 2022年苏格兰地方选举于5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。苏格兰全部32个地方政府的1,226个席位都要改选，投票率为44.8%。与2017年上届选举相比，苏格兰民族党（SNP）增加席位，并继续成为地方政府中的最大党，赢得了36.9%的待选席位。

en.s: The 2022 West Lothian Council election was held on 5 May 2022, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the nine wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 33 Councillors elected. Each ward elects either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system - a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2022年西洛锡安议会选举于5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区，共选出33名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）。

en.s: The 2022 Carmarthenshire County Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2022 to elect 75 members to Carmarthenshire Council. On the same day, elections were held to the other 21 local authorities and to community councils in Wales as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections. Plaid Cymru won a majority of seats for the first time, whilst losing their leader, Emlyn Dole.

zh.s: 2022年卡马森郡议会选举于2022年5月5日星期四举行，选出卡马森郡议会的75名成员。当天，威尔士另外21个地方政府及各社区议会也举行选举，属于2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。威尔士党首次赢得多数席位，但该党领袖Emlyn Dole也在此次选举中失去席位。

en.s: The 2022 West Dunbartonshire Council election was held on 5 May 2022, on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the six wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 22 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system - a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2022年西邓巴顿郡议会选举于5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，共选出22名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）。

en.s: The 2022 Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors — 22 out of 66 — on Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council were elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its longstanding control of the council, holding 52 seats after the election with thirteen Liberal Democrats and one independent.

zh.t: 2022年盖茨黑德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年盖茨黑德都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。66个席位中有22席（三分之一）改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续长期执政，选后拥有52席，另有13名自由民主党议员和1名独立议员。

en.s: Elections to Stirling Council were held on 5 May 2022, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the seven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 23 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw Labour increase their representation on the council by two.

zh.s: 斯特灵议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，共选出23名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。工党在议会中的席位增加了两席。

en.t: 2022 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council took place on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.t: 2022年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2022 Thurrock Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect a third of the members of Thurrock Council in England. Sixteen of the council's 49 seats were contested in sixteen of Thurrock's twenty electoral wards. There are two or three seats in each ward depending on its population. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2022年瑟罗克议会选举于5月5日举行，改选英格兰瑟罗克议会三分之一的席位。瑟罗克49个席位中有16席在20个选区中的16个选区改选。根据各区人口，每个选区有两席或三席。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Sunderland City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Sunderland City Council. This is on the same day as other elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2022年桑德兰市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出桑德兰市议会成员，与英国各地其他选举同日进行。

en.t: 2022 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members to Reigate and Banstead Borough Council in England coinciding with other local elections. Fifteen of the council's 45 seats were up for election. The Conservatives won eight of the fifteen seats available, retaining control of the council which they have held since 2000.

zh.t: 2022年赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同时进行。45个席位中有15席改选。保守党赢得15席中的8席，继续控制议会；该党自2000年以来一直执政。

en.s: The 2022 Flintshire County Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect all 67 councillors on Flintshire County Council in Wales, as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections. The council remained under no overall control, being run by Labour as a minority administration.

zh.s: 2022年弗林特郡议会选举于5月5日举行，改选威尔士弗林特郡议会全部67名议员，是2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。议会仍无人占多数，由工党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2022 Peterborough City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members to Peterborough City Council in Cambridgeshire, England. 19 of the 60 seats were contested, including one by-election in Fletton & Stanground ward. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2022年彼得伯勒市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡彼得伯勒市议会成员。60个席位中有19席改选，其中包括弗莱顿和斯坦格朗选区的一场补选。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Havering London Borough Council election was held on 5 May 2022 to elect all 55 members of Havering London Borough Council. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the council remained under no overall control.

zh.t: 2022年黑弗灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年黑弗灵伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出黑弗灵伦敦自治市议会全部55名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举后，议会仍无人占多数。

en.s: The 2022 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The results were seen as a crucial test for the strength of the Conservative Party in the district following the allegations of Coronavirus rule-breaking in Number 10 by Prime Minister, Boris Johnson.

zh.s: 2022年埃平森林区议会选举于5月5日举行，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。此次选举被视为检验保守党在该区支持度的重要机会，当时首相鲍里斯·约翰逊被指在唐宁街违反新冠防疫规定。

en.s: The 2022 Somerset Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Somerset County Council. The number of councillors was doubled from 55 to 110 at this election, in preparation for the county council becoming a unitary authority on 1 April 2023, when it was renamed Somerset Council. The election coincided with other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2022年萨默塞特郡议会选举于5月5日举行。为筹备郡议会于2023年4月1日转为单一层级地方政府并更名为萨默塞特议会，本次议员人数从55人增至110人。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors—20 out of 60—were elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the council remained under no overall control. The Conservatives continued running a minority administration with a confidence and supply arrangement with smaller parties, as they had done prior to the election.

zh.t: 2022年博尔顿都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年博尔顿都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。议会60个席位中有20席（三分之一）改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，选后无人占多数。保守党继续组建少数派政府，并与较小党派达成信任与供给协议；选举前也是如此。

en.s: The 2022 Falkirk Council election was held on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election used the nine wards created following the Local Government Boundary Commission for Scotland's 5th Review, with 30 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either three or four members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 2022年福尔柯克议会选举于5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。选举使用苏格兰地方政府边界委员会第五次审查后设立的9个选区，共选出30名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2022 Bury Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. Due to boundary changes, all 51 councillors were elected at the same time. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, Labour maintained its control of the council, holding 27 seats after the election.

zh.t: 2022年伯里都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年伯里都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。由于选区边界调整，全体51名议员同时改选。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，选后拥有27席。

en.s: An election to Three Rivers District Council took place on 5 May 2022. 14 of the 39 seats were up for election. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 三河区议会选举于2022年5月5日举行。39个席位中有14席改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2022 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors—20 out of 60—on North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council were elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, holding 50 seats after the election, with nine other councillors from the Conservative Party.

zh.t: 2022年北泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年北泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。60个席位中有20席（三分之一）改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，选后拥有50席，另有9名保守党议员。

en.s: The 2022 East Renfrewshire Council election took place on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 5 wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 18 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 2022年东伦弗鲁郡议会选举于5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的5个选区，共选出18名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2022 Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Walsall Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 21 of the 60 seats were up for election, with 1 ward (Willenhall South) electing 2 councillors.

zh.t: 2022年沃尔索尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年沃尔索尔都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出沃尔索尔议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。60个席位中有21席改选，其中威伦霍尔南选区选出两名议员。

en.s: The 2022 Sutton London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 55 members of Sutton London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the Liberal Democrats maintained their longstanding control of the council, winning 33 out of the 54 seats with the Conservative Party forming the principal opposition with eighteen of the remaining 21 seats.

zh.t: 2022年萨顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年萨顿伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选萨顿伦敦自治市议会全部55名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举中，自由民主党继续长期控制议会，赢得54席中的33席；保守党赢得其余21席中的18席，成为主要反对党。

en.s: The 2022 Oldham Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third—20 out of 60—of councillors on Oldham Council was elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, holding 40 of the council's 60 seats.

zh.t: 2022年奥尔德姆都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年奥尔德姆都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行。60个席位中有20席（三分之一）改选，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，拥有60席中的40席。

en.s: The 2022 Ealing London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022, under new election boundaries, which increased the number of Ealing London Borough Council councillors to 70. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 2022年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，采用新的选区边界，使议会成员人数增至70人。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2022 Haringey London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 57 members of Haringey London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the Labour Party maintained its longstanding control of the council, winning 42 out of the 57 seats with the Liberal Democrats forming the council opposition with the remaining 15 seats.

zh.t: 2022年哈林盖伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年哈林盖伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选哈林盖伦敦自治市议会全部57名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举中，工党继续长期控制议会，赢得57席中的42席；自由民主党赢得其余15席，成为议会反对党。

en.s: The 2022 London local elections took place on 5 May 2022, as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. All London borough councillor seats were up for election. Mayoral elections took place in Hackney, Lewisham, Newham and Tower Hamlets, with Croydon electing a mayor for the first time following a local referendum in October 2021.

zh.s: 2022年伦敦地方选举于5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。伦敦各自治市议会的所有议员席位都要改选。哈克尼、刘易舍姆、新汉姆和塔村举行市长选举；克罗伊登则在2021年10月地方公投后首次选举市长。

en.s: The 2022 Harrow London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 55 members of Harrow London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. The 2022 election took place under new election boundaries, which reduced the number of councillors to 55.

zh.t: 2022年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选哈罗伦敦自治市议会全部55名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。此次按新的选区边界举行，议员人数因此减至55人。

en.s: Elections to Rushmoor Borough Council took place on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.t: 2022年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2022 Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 19 of the 57 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年泰姆赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年泰姆赛德都会自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，选出泰姆赛德都会自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日举行。57个席位中有19席改选。

en.t: 2022 Waltham Forest London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Waltham Forest London Borough Council election was held on 5 May 2022. All 60 members of Waltham Forest London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, winning 47 out of the 60 seats with the Conservative Party forming the council opposition with the remaining 13 seats.

zh.t: 2022年沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，改选议会全部60名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。工党继续控制议会，赢得60席中的47席；保守党赢得其余13席，成为议会反对党。

en.s: Elections to Midlothian Council took place on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 Scottish local elections. The election used the six wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 18 councillors being elected. Each ward elected three members, using the STV electoral system - a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 中洛锡安议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年苏格兰地方选举的一部分。选举使用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，共选出18名议员。每个选区选出3名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）。

en.s: The 2022 Salford City Council election took place on 5 May 2022 along with other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third—20 out of 60—of councillor seats on Salford City Council were up for election. As with the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its longstanding control of the council; Labour lost 3 seats, bringing down its total to 49 of the council's 60 seats.

zh.s: 2022年索尔福德市议会选举于5月5日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。索尔福德市议会60个席位中有20席（三分之一）改选。与2021年上次议会选举一样，工党继续长期控制议会；虽然失去3席，仍拥有60席中的49席。

en.s: The 2022 Inverclyde Council election took place on 5 May 2022, as part of the 2022 Scottish local elections on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local authorities were up for election. The election used the 7 wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, last changed in 2017, with 22 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system.

zh.s: 2022年因弗克莱德议会选举于5月5日举行，是2022年苏格兰地方选举的一部分；苏格兰其他31个地方政府也在同日举行选举。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区（最后一次调整于2017年），共选出22名议员。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The 2022 Renfrewshire Council elections took place on 5 May 2022, as part of the 2022 Scottish local elections on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local authorities were up for election. The election used the 12 wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004 and last changed as a result of the 2015–16 Boundary Commission review, with 43 councillors being elected to Renfrewshire Council.

zh.s: 伦弗鲁郡议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，是2022年苏格兰地方选举的一部分；苏格兰其他31个地方政府也在同日举行选举。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个选区。这些选区最后一次调整是在2015—16年边界委员会审查后实施的，共选出43名伦弗鲁郡议会议员。

en.s: The 2022 South Yorkshire mayoral election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect the Mayor of South Yorkshire, the leader of the South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority. It took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Labour and Co-operative Party candidate, Oliver Coppard, won the election in the second round with 71.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年南约克郡市长选举于5月5日举行，选出南约克郡市长，该职位负责领导南约克郡市长联合管理局。选举与英国各地其他地方选举同时举行。工党与合作党候选人Oliver Coppard在第二轮投票中胜出，得票率为71.4%。

en.s: The 2022 Watford Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third (12) of the 36 members of Watford Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom, and an election for the Mayor of Watford. The Liberal Democrats went into the election controlling the council, holding 24 of the 36 seats.

zh.t: 2022年沃特福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年沃特福德自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选沃特福德自治市议会36名成员中的三分之一（12席）。选举与英国各地的地方政府及沃特福德市长选举同时举行。自由民主党在选举前控制议会，拥有36席中的24席。

en.s: The 2022 Manchester City Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors on Manchester City Council were elected. This election was a part of the other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, the Labour Party maintained its longstanding control of the council, holding 94 of the council's 96 seats.

zh.s: 2022年曼彻斯特市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选曼彻斯特市议会三分之一的议员，是英国各地其他地方选举的一部分。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续长期控制议会，选后拥有96席中的94席。

en.t: 2022 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 45 members of Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 2022年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选议会全部45名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2022 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election
en.s: The 2022 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect one third of councillors to the City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, Labour maintained its control of the council, holding 51 seats after the election.

zh.t: 2022年布拉德福德市都会区议会选举
zh.s: 2022年布拉德福德市都会区议会选举于5月5日举行，改选该议会三分之一的议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同时进行。上一次议会选举于2021年举行，工党继续控制议会，选后拥有51席。

en.s: The 2022 Wandsworth London Borough Council elections took place on 5 May 2022. All 58 members of Wandsworth London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the Conservative Party maintained their longstanding control of the council, winning 33 out of the 60 seats with the Labour Party forming the principal opposition with 26 of the remaining 27 seats.

zh.t: 2022年旺兹沃思伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年旺兹沃思伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选议会全部58名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举中，保守党继续长期控制议会，赢得60席中的33席；工党赢得其余27席中的26席，成为主要反对党。

en.s: The 2022 Winchester City Council election was held on 5 May 2022. This was on the same day as other local elections across Great Britain.

zh.s: 温彻斯特市议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2022 North Yorkshire Council election took place on 5 May 2022, alongside the other local elections. These were the last elections to North Yorkshire County Council, and the elected councillors would also serve as the first councillors on the North Yorkshire Council (a new unitary authority), which replaced the existing county council in April 2023.

zh.s: 2022年北约克郡议会选举于5月5日举行，与其他地方选举同时进行。这是北约克郡郡议会的最后一次选举。当选议员也将成为新单一层级地方政府——北约克郡议会的首届议员；该议会于2023年4月取代原郡议会。

en.s: The 2022 Newham London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 66 members of Newham London Borough Council were elected. The election took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous 2018 local election, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, winning all 60 seats.

zh.t: 2022年新汉姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年新汉姆伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选议会全部66名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次地方选举中，工党继续控制议会，赢得全部60席。

en.s: Elections to Southampton City Council took place on Thursday 5 May 2022, alongside nationwide local elections, alongside other local elections across the country. The seats up for election were last contested in 2018. The Labour Party regained control of the council from the Conservative Party, which it had lost at the previous year's elections.

en.s: The 2022 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors — 15 out of 45 — on Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council were elected. en.t: 2022 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 51 members of Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council were elected. en.s: The 2022 Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. One third of councillors — 21 out of 63 — were elected. en.t: 2022 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. Due to boundary changes, all 48 councillors were elected at the same time, with the council moving to a system of all-out elections every four years. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. In the previous council election in 2021, Labour maintained its control of the council, holding 35 seats after the election.

zh.t: 2022年圣海伦斯都会自治市议会选举

en.s: Elections to The Highland Council were held on 5 May 2022, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 高地议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，此次采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.t: 2022 Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2022 Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect all 48 members of Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council. The Liberal Democrats retained overall majority control of the council, the fifth time in the last six elections that the party has won overall control.

zh.t: 2022年伊斯灵顿伦敦自治市议会选举

en.s: The East Dunbartonshire Council election of 2022 was held on 5 May 2022, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. zh.s: 东邓巴顿郡议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。各选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可让渡投票制。这一选举制度自2007年选举起使用，依据《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》实施。

en.s: The 2022 Birmingham City Council election took place on 5 May 2022, with all 101 council seats up for election across 37 single-member and 32 two-member wards. The election was held alongside other local elections across Great Britain and town council elections in Sutton Coldfield. In the previous council election in 2018, the first all-out elections in Birmingham, Labour maintained its control of the council, winning 67 seats.

zh.s: 2022年伯明翰市议会选举于5月5日举行，伯明翰市议会全部101个席位都要改选，分布在37个单议员选区和32个双议员选区。选举与英国各地其他地方选举及萨顿科尔菲尔德镇议会选举同时举行。2018年上一次全体改选时，工党继续控制议会，赢得67席。

en.s: The 2022 Brent London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 57 members of Brent London Borough Council were to be elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, winning 60 out of the 63 seats with the Conservative Party forming the council opposition with the remaining three seats.

zh.t: 2022年布伦特伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年布伦特伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选议会全部57名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举中，工党继续控制议会，赢得63席中的60席；保守党赢得其余3席，成为议会反对党。

en.s: The 2022 Camden London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022. All 55 members of Camden London Borough Council were elected. The elections took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. In the previous election in 2018, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, winning 43 out of the 54 seats with the Conservative Party forming the primary opposition with seven of the remaining seats.

zh.t: 2022年卡姆登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2022年卡姆登伦敦自治市议会选举于5月5日举行，改选议会全部55名成员。选举与伦敦其他自治市及英国各地的地方选举同时进行。2018年上次选举中，工党继续控制议会，赢得54席中的43席；保守党赢得其余席位中的7席，成为主要反对党。

en.s: Elections to the Orkney Islands Council were held on 5 May 2022 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。与苏格兰其他地方议会选举一样，此次采用单记可让渡投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. 17 of the 51 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2022年索利赫尔都会自治市议会选举

en.t: 2022 Isle of Anglesey County Council election
en.s: The 2022 Isle of Anglesey County Council election took place on Thursday 5 May 2022 to elect all 35 members of Isle of Anglesey County Council. It was held on the same day as all other councils in Wales, as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections.

zh.s: 2022年安格尔西岛郡议会选举于2022年5月5日星期四举行，改选安格尔西岛郡议会全部35名成员。选举与威尔士其他地方政府选举同日举行，是2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。

en.s: Elections to Portsmouth City Council took place on Thursday 5 May 2022, alongside other local elections across the country. The seats contested in this election were last contested in 2018. The Conservative Party had 6 seats they were defending, while the Liberal Democrats and Labour were both defending 4 seats. No party gained a majority from this election, and therefore the council remains under no overall control, with the Liberal Democrats continuing to run the council in a minority.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2022年5月5日星期四举行，与全国各地其他地方选举同时进行。本次改选的席位上次于2018年改选。保守党有6席需要竞选连任，自由民主党和工党各有4席需要竞选连任。没有政党赢得多数，因此议会仍无人占多数，由自由民主党继续以少数派形式执政。

en.s: The 2022 election to Monmouthshire County Council took place on 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 Welsh local elections. The Welsh Conservatives lost overall control of the council, whilst the Lib Dems were wiped out. The Greens elected their first councillor in Monmouthshire in the Llantilio Crossenny ward. Following the election Labour formed a minority administration, though they formed a coalition with the Greens in May 2023.

zh.s: 2022年蒙茅斯郡议会选举于5月5日举行，是2022年威尔士地方选举的一部分。威尔士保守党失去议会多数，自由民主党则失去全部席位。绿党在兰蒂利奥克罗斯尼选区选出该郡首位议员。选举后工党组建少数派政府，并于2023年5月与绿党组建联合政府。

en.s: The 2022 Enfield London Borough Council election took place on 5 May 2022, alongside local elections in the other London boroughs and elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom. All 63 members of Enfield London Borough Council were elected. In the previous election in 2018, the Labour Party maintained its control of the council, winning 46 out of the 63 seats with the Conservative Party forming the council opposition with the remaining 17 seats.

en.s: 2022 Elections to Scottish Borders Council were held on 5 May 2022, the same day as the other Scottish local elections. The Scottish Greens won their first ever seat on the council. zh.s: 苏格兰边区议会选举于2022年5月5日举行，与苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。苏格兰绿党首次赢得该议会席位。选举后，保守党与独立议员Caroline Cochrane、Stuart Marshall和Watson McAteer组建执政班子。

en.s: Elections to South Cambridgeshire District Council were held on Thursday 5 May 2022 as part of the 2022 United Kingdom local elections. All forty five seats were up for election in twenty six wards. The Liberal Democrats were defending the council, having won control in 2018.

en.s: The 2023 Egyptian Super Cup was the 20th Egyptian Super Cup, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Egyptian Premier League and Egypt Cup. The match is usually contested by the winners of the Egyptian League and the Egypt Cup, but after the withdrawal of Zamalek. Pyramids qualified by default as the runners-up of the cup, and Al Ahly after winning the ( 2021–22 Egypt Cup) . The match was played on 5 May 2023 and for the 6th time in the United Arab Emirates at the Mohammed bin Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi.

zh.s: 2023年埃及超级杯是第20届赛事，每年由上赛季埃及超级联赛和埃及杯的冠军进行一场比赛。通常参赛队伍是埃及联赛和埃及杯的冠军，但扎马雷克退出后，埃及杯亚军金字塔队自动获得参赛资格；阿赫利队则因赢得2021—22赛季埃及杯而参赛。比赛于2023年5月5日在阿联酋阿布扎比的穆罕默德·本·扎耶德体育场举行，这是该赛事第六次在阿联酋举办。

en.s: The 2024 National League play-off final, known as the Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons, was an association football match played on 5 May 2024 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Bromley and Solihull Moors. The match determined the second and final team to gain promotion from the National League, the fifth tier of English football, to EFL League Two.

zh.t: 2024年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因又称Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，是一场足球比赛，于2024年5月5日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布罗姆利对阵索利赫尔沼地队。比赛决定全国联赛（英格兰足球第五级别）中第二支、也是最后一支升入英格兰足球联赛第二区的球队。

en.s: General elections were held in Panama on 5 May 2024 to elect a new president, members of the National Assembly and local governments. Due to constitutional term limits, incumbent president Laurentino Cortizo was ineligible for a second consecutive term. The winners of the general election, including the new president of Panama, were inaugurated on 1 July.

zh.s: 巴拿马于2024年5月5日举行大选，选出新总统、国民议会议员和地方政府成员。根据宪法任期限制，时任总统劳伦蒂诺·科尔蒂索不能连续竞选第二个任期。包括新任巴拿马总统在内的当选者于7月1日宣誓就职。

en.t: 2024 Copa de la Liga Profesional final
en.s: On May 5, 2024, Estudiantes de La Plata and Vélez Sarsfield drew 1–1 in the Copa de la Liga Profesional final in Santiago del Estero, Argentina. Estudiantes won the penalty shootout 4–3.

zh.s: 2024年5月5日，拉普拉塔大学生与萨斯菲尔德在阿根廷圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗举行的职业联赛杯决赛中战成1比1，大学生队随后在点球大战中以4比3获胜。

en.s: The 2024 AFC Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 AFC Cup, the 19th edition of the AFC Cup, Asia's secondary club football tournament organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC), and the final edition under the AFC Cup title, as the competition was revamped under the name AFC Champions League Two starting in 2024–25. The final was contested as a single match between Al-Ahed from Lebanon and Central Coast Mariners from Australia. The match was played at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex in Muscat on 5 May 2024.

zh.s: 2024年亚足联杯决赛是2023—24赛季亚足联杯的决赛，也是该赛事第19届。亚足联杯是由亚洲足球联合会（AFC）主办的亚洲俱乐部足球第二级赛事；这也是以「亚足联杯」为名的最后一届比赛，因为赛事自2024—25赛季起改组为亚足联冠军联赛二级联赛。决赛采用单场制，由黎巴嫩的阿赫德队对阵澳大利亚的中央海岸水手队，于2024年5月5日在阿曼马斯喀特的苏丹卡布斯体育中心举行。

en.s: The 2025 Makhachkala clash was a spontaneous clash between Dagestani militants and the local police upon a routine stop conducted by traffic police, leaving several police officers and militants dead.

zh.s: 2025年马哈奇卡拉冲突是达吉斯坦武装人员与当地警方之间的一场突发冲突，起因是交警进行例行拦查。冲突造成数名警员和武装人员死亡。
